#pragma once

#include "terraingen/random/stream.h"

#include <limits>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

namespace terraingen {

enum class SfdKind {
    Density,         
    ProductionRate,  
};

struct DiameterRange {
    double min = 0.0;                                      
    double max = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();  

    bool Contains(double diameter) const {
        return diameter > 0.0 && diameter >= min && diameter <= max;
    }
};

class SizeFrequencyDistribution {
  public:
    virtual ~SizeFrequencyDistribution() = default;

    SfdKind Kind() const {
        return m_kind;
    }

    const DiameterRange& ValidRange() const {
        return m_range;
    }

    bool AllowsExtrapolation() const {
        return m_extrapolate;
    }

    void SetAllowExtrapolation(bool allow) {
        m_extrapolate = allow;
    }

    double Cumulative(double diameter) const;

    double Incremental(double diameter) const;

    double ExpectedCount(double area, double minDiameter, double maxDiameter) const;

    double SampleDiameter(RandomStream& random, double minDiameter, double maxDiameter) const;

  protected:
    SizeFrequencyDistribution(SfdKind kind, DiameterRange range);

    virtual double CumulativeAt(double diameter) const = 0;

    virtual double IncrementalAt(double diameter) const;

    virtual double InvertCumulative(double target, double minDiameter, double maxDiameter) const;

    static double UncheckedCumulative(const SizeFrequencyDistribution& distribution,
                                      double diameter) {
        return distribution.CumulativeAt(diameter);
    }

    static double UncheckedIncremental(const SizeFrequencyDistribution& distribution,
                                       double diameter) {
        return distribution.IncrementalAt(diameter);
    }

    static double UncheckedInverse(const SizeFrequencyDistribution& distribution, double target,
                                   double minDiameter, double maxDiameter) {
        return distribution.InvertCumulative(target, minDiameter, maxDiameter);
    }

  private:
    void CheckDiameter(double diameter) const;

    SfdKind m_kind;
    DiameterRange m_range;
    bool m_extrapolate = false;
};

    return std::atan(std::hypot(dx, dy)) * kRadian;
}

struct Vec2d {
    double x = 0.0;
    double y = 0.0;

    bool operator==(const Vec2d& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y;
    }
    bool operator!=(const Vec2d& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

inline Vec2d operator+(const Vec2d& a, const Vec2d& b) {
    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y};
}

inline Vec2d operator-(const Vec2d& a, const Vec2d& b) {
    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y};
}

inline Vec2d operator-(const Vec2d& v) {
    return {-v.x, -v.y};
}

inline Vec2d operator*(const Vec2d& v, double s) {
    return {v.x * s, v.y * s};
}

inline Vec2d operator/(const Vec2d& v, double s) {
    return {v.x / s, v.y / s};
}

struct Vec3d {
    double x = 0.0;
    double y = 0.0;
    double z = 0.0;

    bool operator==(const Vec3d& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y && z == other.z;
    }
    bool operator!=(const Vec3d& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

inline Vec3d operator+(const Vec3d& a, const Vec3d& b) {
    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
}

inline Vec3d operator-(const Vec3d& a, const Vec3d& b) {
    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
}

inline Vec3d operator-(const Vec3d& v) {
    return {-v.x, -v.y, -v.z};
}

inline Vec3d operator*(const Vec3d& v, double s) {
    return {v.x * s, v.y * s, v.z * s};
}

inline Vec3d operator/(const Vec3d& v, double s) {
    return {v.x / s, v.y / s, v.z / s};
}

inline double Dot(const Vec3d& a, const Vec3d& b) {
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

inline Vec3d Cross(const Vec3d& a, const Vec3d& b) {
    return {a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x};
}

inline double Length(const Vec3d& v) {
    return std::sqrt(Dot(v, v));
}

inline Vec3d Normalized(const Vec3d& v) {
    const double length = Length(v);
    return length > 0.0 ? v * (1.0 / length) : v;
}

struct Bounds2d {
    double minX = 0.0;
    double minY = 0.0;
    double maxX = 0.0;
    double maxY = 0.0;

    bool IsFinite() const {
        return std::isfinite(minX) && std::isfinite(minY) && std::isfinite(maxX) &&
               std::isfinite(maxY);
    }

    Vec2d Center() const {
        return {0.5 * (minX + maxX), 0.5 * (minY + maxY)};
    }

    bool Contains(double x, double y) const {
        return x >= minX && x < maxX && y >= minY && y < maxY;
    }

    Bounds2d Expanded(double margin) const {
        return {minX - margin, minY - margin, maxX + margin, maxY + margin};
    }

    bool operator==(const Bounds2d& other) const {
        return minX == other.minX && minY == other.minY && maxX == other.maxX && maxY == other.maxY;
    }
    bool operator!=(const Bounds2d& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

inline Bounds2d PointBounds(double x, double y) {
    constexpr double kInf = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
    return {x, y, std::nextafter(x, kInf), std::nextafter(y, kInf)};
}

#pragma once

#include "terraingen/geometry/geometry.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <functional>
#include <vector>

namespace terraingen {

constexpr std::size_t IcqLabelIndex(std::size_t q, std::size_t i, std::size_t j, std::size_t face) {
    return ((face - 1) * (q + 1) + j) * (q + 1) + i;
}

template <typename Visit> void ForEachIcqLabel(std::size_t q, const Visit& visit) {
    for (std::size_t face = 1; face <= 6; ++face) {
        for (std::size_t j = 0; j <= q; ++j) {
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i <= q; ++i) {
                visit(i, j, face, IcqLabelIndex(q, i, j, face));
            }
        }
    }
}

class RadialShape {
  public:
    static RadialShape Sample(std::size_t q, const std::function<double(const Vec3d&)>& radius);

class Surface {
  public:
    Surface() = default;

    static Surface Plane() {
        return {};
    }

    static Surface Sphere(double radius);

    static Surface Ellipsoid(double a, double b, double c);

    static Surface ShapeModel(std::shared_ptr<const RadialShape> shape);

    bool IsBody() const {
        return m_form != Form::Plane;
    }

    bool IsSphere() const {
        return m_form == Form::Sphere;
    }

    const RadialShape* Shape() const {
        return m_shape.get();
    }

    double MinRadius() const;

    double MaxRadius() const;

    double Radius() const {
        return m_radius;
    }

    Vec3d Radii() const {
        return m_radii;
    }

    double RadiusAt(const Vec2d& point) const;

    double AreaPerSteradian(const Vec2d& point) const;

    double UnitLength() const {
        return m_form == Form::Plane ? 1.0 : m_unitLength;
    }

    Vec2d Offset(const Vec2d& center, const Vec2d& point) const {
        switch (m_form) {
        case Form::Plane:
            return point - center;
        case Form::Sphere:
            return SphereOffset(center, point);
        case Form::Ellipsoid:
        case Form::Shape:
            break;
        }
        return TangentOffset(center, point);
    }

    Vec2d Locate(const Vec2d& center, const Vec2d& offset) const {
        switch (m_form) {
        case Form::Plane:
            return center + offset;
        case Form::Sphere:
            return SphereLocate(center, offset);
        case Form::Ellipsoid:
        case Form::Shape:
            break;
        }
        return TangentLocate(center, offset);
    }

    double Distance(const Vec2d& a, const Vec2d& b) const;

    Vec3d Position(const Vec2d& point) const;

    LocalFrame Frame(const Vec2d& point) const;

    Vec2d Coordinates(const Vec3d& direction) const;

    Bounds2d Expand(const Bounds2d& region, double meters) const;

    bool Contains(const Bounds2d& region, const Vec2d& point) const {
        if (region.Contains(point.x, point.y)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (m_form == Form::Plane) {
            return false;
        }
        const Vec2d pole{point.x, point.y >= 90.0 && region.maxY >= 90.0 ? region.minY : point.y};
        return region.Contains(pole.x, pole.y) || region.Contains(pole.x - 360.0, pole.y) ||
               region.Contains(pole.x + 360.0, pole.y);
    }

    BucketIndex Bucket(const Vec2d& point, double size) const;

    bool operator==(const Surface& other) const {
        return m_form == other.m_form && m_radius == other.m_radius &&
               m_unitLength == other.m_unitLength && m_radii == other.m_radii &&
               m_shape == other.m_shape;
    }
    bool operator!=(const Surface& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }

  private:
    enum class Form {
        Plane,      
        Sphere,     
        Ellipsoid,  
        Shape,      
    };

    bool IsNonSphere() const {
        return m_form == Form::Ellipsoid || m_form == Form::Shape;
    }

    Vec2d SphereOffset(const Vec2d& center, const Vec2d& point) const;
    Vec2d SphereLocate(const Vec2d& center, const Vec2d& offset) const;
    Vec2d TangentOffset(const Vec2d& center, const Vec2d& point) const;
    Vec2d TangentLocate(const Vec2d& center, const Vec2d& offset) const;
    double EllipsoidDepth(const Vec3d& q, const Vec3d& up) const;
    double ShapeDepth(const Vec3d& q, const Vec3d& up) const;
    Vec3d Normal(const Vec2d& point, const Vec3d& p) const;

    Form m_form = Form::Plane;
    double m_radius = 0.0;
    double m_unitLength = 1.0;
    Vec3d m_radii{};
    std::shared_ptr<const RadialShape> m_shape;
};

template <typename IO> void Fields(IO& io, BedformOptions& bedforms) {
    io("wavelength_m", bedforms.wavelength,

       Above(0.0));
    io("height_m", bedforms.height,
       "Trough-to-crest height, in meters, scaled with each field's wavelength.", "m",
       AtLeast(0.0));
    io("wind_azimuth_deg", bedforms.windAzimuthDegrees,
       WindAzimuthHelp("wind", "crests lie across it"), "deg");
    io("azimuth_spread_deg", bedforms.azimuthSpreadDegrees,
       "Largest difference of each field's wind from the azimuth, in degrees.", "deg",
       AtLeast(0.0));
    io("lee_fraction", bedforms.leeFraction,
       "Share of a wavelength the lee face takes: 0.5 is symmetric, lower values give a steeper "
       "lee face.",
       "", Inside(0.0, 1.0));
    io("sinuosity", bedforms.sinuosity,
       "How far a crest wanders along its length, in wavelengths; 0 gives straight crests.", "",
       AtLeast(0.0));
    io("cover", bedforms.cover, "Share of the ground under bedform fields; 0 gives no bedforms.",
       "", Between(0.0, 0.9));
    io("field_size_m", bedforms.fieldSize, "Typical width of a bedform field, in meters.", "m",
       Above(0.0));
    io("seed", bedforms.seed,
       "Seed of the fields and their crests; changing it gives a different layout of the same "
       "statistics.");
    ExposureFields(io, bedforms.exposure, bedforms.exposureSpacing,
                   "Leaves out fields whose centers lie on bedrock, the likelier the barer the "
                   "ground, as sand settles in lows; unset disables it.");
    FadePixelFields(
        io, bedforms.fade,
        "How bedforms too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength.");
    SourceResolvesField(io, bedforms.sourceResolvesPixels, "bedforms", "wavelength");
}

namespace terraingen {

enum class DensityMeasure {
    Scale,          
    Count,          
    ArealFraction,  
};

struct DensityMap {
    std::shared_ptr<const SurfaceField> field;       
    DensityMeasure measure = DensityMeasure::Scale;  
    double minDiameter = 0.0;  
    double maxDiameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
    double areaUnit = 1.0;  
    bool total = true;

    bool operator==(const DensityMap& other) const {
        return field == other.field && measure == other.measure &&
               minDiameter == other.minDiameter && maxDiameter == other.maxDiameter &&
               areaUnit == other.areaUnit && total == other.total;
    }
};

enum class SizeSlopeMeasure {
    Exponent,  
    MeanDiameter,
};

struct SizeSlopeMap {
    std::shared_ptr<const SurfaceField> field;              
    SizeSlopeMeasure measure = SizeSlopeMeasure::Exponent;  
    double referenceDiameter = 1.0;  
    double minExponent = 1.0;
    double maxExponent = 6.0;  

    bool operator==(const SizeSlopeMap& other) const {
        return field == other.field && measure == other.measure &&
               referenceDiameter == other.referenceDiameter && minExponent == other.minExponent &&

// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause

#pragma once

#include "terraingen/noise/hash.h"
#include "terraingen/util/bits.h"
#include "terraingen/util/lru_cache.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>

namespace terraingen {

class EvaluationCache {
  public:
    explicit EvaluationCache(std::size_t capacity = 1 << 20)
        : m_values(capacity, [](const Holder&) { return std::size_t{1}; }), m_id(NextId()) {}

    std::uint64_t Id() const {
        return m_id;
    }

    template <typename T>
    std::shared_ptr<const T> Get(const void* owner, std::uint64_t id, double spacing,
                                 const std::function<T()>& compute) {
        const Key key{reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(owner), id, BitCast<std::uint64_t>(spacing)};
        const std::shared_ptr<const Holder> held =
            m_values.Get(key, [&] { return Holder{std::make_shared<const T>(compute())}; });
        return std::static_pointer_cast<const T>(held->value);
    }

    template <typename T>
    std::shared_ptr<const T> Find(const void* owner, std::uint64_t id, double spacing) {
        const Key key{reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(owner), id, BitCast<std::uint64_t>(spacing)};
        const std::shared_ptr<const Holder> held = m_values.Find(key);
        return held ? std::static_pointer_cast<const T>(held->value) : nullptr;
    }

  private:
    struct Key {
        std::uintptr_t owner = 0;
        std::uint64_t id = 0;
        std::uint64_t spacing = 0;

        bool operator==(const Key& other) const {
            return owner == other.owner && id == other.id && spacing == other.spacing;
        }
    };
    struct KeyHash {
        std::size_t operator()(const Key& key) const {
            return HashWords({static_cast<std::uint64_t>(key.owner), key.id, key.spacing});
        }
    };
    struct Holder {
        std::shared_ptr<const void> value;
    };

    static std::uint64_t NextId() {
        static std::atomic<std::uint64_t> next{1};
        return next.fetch_add(1);
    }

    LruCache<Key, Holder, KeyHash> m_values;
    std::uint64_t m_id;
};

}  // namespace terraingen

std::shared_ptr<const T> Replacement(const std::shared_ptr<const T>& layer,
                                     const LayerReplacements& replaced) {
    for (const auto& entry : replaced) {
        if (entry.first == layer.get()) {
            if (auto same = std::dynamic_pointer_cast<const T>(entry.second)) {
                return same;
            }
        }
    }
    return layer;
}

template <typename IO>
void FadePixelFields(IO& io, ResolutionFade& fade, std::string_view description) {
    if constexpr (BindsNative<IO>) {
        if (io.Group("fade", fade, description)) {
            return;
        }
    }
    std::array<double, 2> pixels{fade.startSamples, fade.endSamples};
    io("fade_px", pixels, description, "px", AtLeast(0.0));
    fade.startSamples = pixels[0];
    fade.endSamples = pixels[1];
    io("fade_shape", fade.shape, "Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.");
}

template <typename IO>
void SourceResolvesField(IO& io, std::optional<double>& pixels, std::string_view features,
                         std::string_view size) {
    io("source_resolves_px", pixels,
       "Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the " +
           std::string(features) + ", by their " + std::string(size) +
           ": only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. "
           "Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all.",
       "px", Above(0.0));
}

struct SelectionKeys {
    std::string_view minDiameter = "min_diameter_m";
    std::string_view maxDiameter = "max_diameter_m";
    std::string_view minAge = "min_age_gyr";
    std::string_view maxAge = "max_age_gyr";
    std::string_view manual = "manual";
};

template <typename IO, typename Selection>
void SelectionFields(IO& io, Selection& selection, std::string_view craters,
                     std::string_view manualHelp, const SelectionKeys& keys = {}) {
    if constexpr (BindsNative<IO>) {
        if (io.Group("selection", selection,
                     "The selection of " + std::string(craters) +
                         ": their diameters and ages, and whether manual craters count.")) {
            return;
        }
    }
    const std::string of = ", of " + std::string(craters);
    io(keys.minDiameter, selection.minDiameter, "Smallest diameter, in meters" + of + ".", "m",
       AtLeast(0.0));
    OptionalBound(io, keys.maxDiameter, selection.maxDiameter,
                  "Largest diameter, in meters" + of + "; unset has no upper limit.", "m",
                  std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), AtLeast(0.0));
    io(keys.minAge, selection.minAgeGyr, "Youngest age, in Gyr" + of + ".", "Gyr", AtLeast(0.0));
    OptionalBound(io, keys.maxAge, selection.maxAgeGyr,
                  "Oldest age, in Gyr" + of + "; unset has no upper limit.", "Gyr",
                  std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), AtLeast(0.0));
    io(keys.manual, selection.manual, manualHelp);
}

inline std::string WindAzimuthHelp(std::string_view wind, std::string_view effect) {
    return "Direction the " + std::string(wind) +
           " blows toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); " +
           std::string(effect) + ".";
}

template <typename IO, typename Anchor>
void AnchorFields(IO& io, Anchor& anchor, std::string_view what,
                  std::string_view prefix = "anchor") {
    if constexpr (BindsNative<IO>) {
        if (io.Group(prefix, anchor,
                     "On a body, the longitude and latitude in degrees of the point whose tangent "
                     "frame " +
                         std::string(what) + ".")) {
            return;
        }
    }
    io(std::string(prefix) + "_x", anchor.x,
       "On a body, the longitude in degrees of the point whose tangent frame " + std::string(what) +
           ".");
    io(std::string(prefix) + "_y", anchor.y, "On a body, the latitude in degrees of the anchor.");
}

template <typename IO> void Fields(IO& io, ResolutionFade& fade) {
    io("start_samples", fade.startSamples,

    io("reach_m", exposure.reach,

       "lows.",

    io("rise_soil", exposure.riseSoil,

    io("rise_boulder", exposure.riseBoulder,
       "Height above the surroundings, as a share of the reach, at or above which the ground is "
       "bedrock; above the soil threshold.");
    io("slope_soil", exposure.slopeSoil, "Slope, as rise over run, at or under which soil holds.");
    io("slope_boulder", exposure.slopeBoulder,
       "Slope, as rise over run, at or over which no soil holds and the ground is bedrock; above "
       "the soil threshold.");
    io("floor_cover", exposure.floorCover,
       "Share of level ground that is bedrock too, in noise patches, as on a swept lava floor; 0 "
       "for none.",

template <typename IO> void Fields(IO& io, RasterFieldOptions& options) {
    io("method", options.method,

    OptionalBound(io, "fallback", options.fallback,

                  "none, and the layer then keeps its own setting there.",
                  "", std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN());
    io("periodic_longitude", options.periodicLongitude,
       "The raster's x is longitude repeating every 360 degrees, so a map from 0 to 360 serves "
       "-180 to 180.");
}

template <typename IO> void Fields(IO& io, DensityMap& map) {
    io("measure", map.measure, "What the map's values measure.");
    io("min_diameter_m", map.minDiameter,
       "Smallest diameter the map measures, in meters; positive for a count or areal fraction.",
       "m", AtLeast(0.0));
    OptionalBound(io, "max_diameter_m", map.maxDiameter,
                  "Largest diameter the map measures, in meters, exclusive; unset for no limit.",
                  "m", std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), Above(0.0));
    io("area_unit", map.areaUnit,
       "Square meters per area unit of a count: 1 for per m^2, 1e6 for per km^2.", "m^2",
       Above(0.0));
    io("total", map.total,
       "The map counts every feature of its kind, including the secondaries thrown from a crater "
       "layer's craters and the boulders a layer throws out around craters, which are taken out "
       "of it first; off when it counts only what the layer generates.");
}

template <typename IO> void Fields(IO& io, SizeSlopeMap& map) {
    io("measure", map.measure, "What the map's values measure.");
    io("reference_diameter_m", map.referenceDiameter,
       "Diameter D0 in meters where the local power law meets the layer's own count, as N(>=D) = "
       "N(>=D0) (D / D0)^-alpha; for a mean diameter map, the smallest diameter averaged.",
       "m", Above(0.0));
    io("min_exponent", map.minExponent,
       "Smallest exponent alpha the map's values are clamped to; with the largest it bounds the "
       "boulders drawn, so generous bounds draw more to thin.",
       "", Above(0.0));
    io("max_exponent", map.maxExponent,
       "Largest exponent alpha the map's values are clamped to; above the smallest.", "",
       Above(0.0));
}

inline constexpr std::string_view kRmsSlopeHelp =
    "RMS slope, as rise over run, over the baseline when every octave is resolved; higher values "
    "give rougher ground.";

inline constexpr std::string_view kRoughnessHurstHelp =
    "Hurst exponent: octave amplitudes grow as wavelength^hurst, so lower values put relatively "
    "more roughness at short wavelengths.";

template <typename IO> void RoughnessOctaveFields(IO& io, RoughnessOptions& roughness) {
    io("max_wavelength_m", roughness.maxWavelength, "Wavelength of the longest octave, in meters.",
       "m", Above(0.0));
    io("min_wavelength_m", roughness.minWavelength,
       "Wavelength of the shortest octave, in meters; octaves halve from the longest down to it, "
       "spanning at most 40 octaves.",
       "m", Above(0.0));
    io("seed", roughness.seed,
       "Seed of the noise; changing it gives a different pattern of the same roughness.");
    FadePixelFields(
        io, roughness.fade,
        "How octaves too fine to resolve at the sample spacing fade out, by samples per "
        "wavelength.");
}

template <typename IO> void Fields(IO& io, RoughnessOptions& roughness) {
    io("rms_slope", roughness.rmsSlope, std::string(kRmsSlopeHelp), "", Above(0.0));
    io("baseline_m", roughness.baseline, "Baseline the RMS slope is given over, in meters.", "m",
       Above(0.0));
    io("hurst", roughness.hurst, std::string(kRoughnessHurstHelp), "", AboveUpTo(0.0, 1.0));
    RoughnessOctaveFields(io, roughness);
}

template <typename IO>
void SpectralSynthesisFields(IO& io, double& minWavelength, double& taperOctaves,
                             std::uint32_t& seed, ResolutionFade& fade) {
    io("min_wavelength_m", minWavelength,
       "Shortest wavelength of the detail in meters; the detail spans the wavelengths from twice "
       "the source's pixel size down to it.",
       "m", Above(0.0));
    io("taper_octaves", taperOctaves,
       "Octaves above the source's Nyquist frequency over which the detail fades in, so it adds "
       "nothing at wavelengths the source resolves.",
       "", Above(0.0));
    io("seed", seed,
       "Seed of the detail; changing it gives a different pattern of the same "
       "spectrum.");
    FadePixelFields(
        io, fade,
        "How wavelengths too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength.");
}

template <typename IO> void Fields(IO& io, SpectralContinuationOptions& options) {
    io("pixel_size_m", options.pixelSize,
       "Cell size of the source in meters; the detail starts at twice it, the source's Nyquist "
       "wavelength.",
       "m", Above(0.0));
    io("slope", options.slope,
       "Spectral slope beta of the radially averaged power spectrum, P(f) ~ f^-beta: beta = 2 H "
       "+ 2 for Hurst exponent H.",
       "", Between(2.0, 4.0));
    io("octave_rms_m", options.octaveRms,
       "RMS height in meters the power law holds at wavelengths from one to two source pixels.",
       "m", AtLeast(0.0));
    SpectralSynthesisFields(io, options.minWavelength, options.taperOctaves, options.seed,
                            options.fade);
}

#pragma once

#include "terraingen/geometry/geometry.h"

#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace terraingen {

struct RegionShape {
    enum class Kind { Rectangle, Circle, Polygon };

    Kind kind = Kind::Rectangle;  
    Bounds2d rectangle{};         
    Vec2d center{};               
    double radius = 0.0;          
    std::vector<Vec2d>
        points{};  
    std::vector<std::vector<Vec2d>> holes{};  

    static RegionShape Rectangle(const Bounds2d& bounds) {
        RegionShape shape;
        shape.rectangle = bounds;
        return shape;
    }
    static RegionShape Circle(Vec2d center, double radius) {
        RegionShape shape;
        shape.kind = Kind::Circle;
        shape.center = center;
        shape.radius = radius;
        return shape;
    }
    static RegionShape Polygon(std::vector<Vec2d> points,
                               std::vector<std::vector<Vec2d>> holes = {}) {
        RegionShape shape;
        shape.kind = Kind::Polygon;
        shape.points = std::move(points);
        shape.holes = std::move(holes);
        return shape;
    }

    double DistanceOutside(double x, double y, const Surface& surface = {}) const;

    Bounds2d Bounds(const Surface& surface = {}) const;

    bool operator==(const RegionShape& other) const {
        return kind == other.kind && rectangle.minX == other.rectangle.minX &&
               rectangle.minY == other.rectangle.minY && rectangle.maxX == other.rectangle.maxX &&
               rectangle.maxY == other.rectangle.maxY && center == other.center &&
               radius == other.radius && points == other.points && holes == other.holes;
    }
    bool operator!=(const RegionShape& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

void ValidateRegionShape(const RegionShape& shape);

class MaskedLayer final : public Layer, public CraterPlacer, public BoulderPlacer {
  public:
    MaskedLayer(std::shared_ptr<const Layer> inner, RegionShape shape, double feather = 0.0,
                BlendShape blend = BlendShape::Smoothstep);

    double Weight(double x, double y, const Surface& surface = {}) const;

    const Layer& Inner() const {
        return *m_inner;
    }

    std::optional<TerrainBase> LayerBase() const override {
        return m_inner->LayerBase();
    }

    double GroundReach(double spacing) const override {
        return m_inner->GroundReach(spacing);
    }

    std::vector<const Layer*> Dependencies() const override {
        return m_inner->Dependencies();
    }

    LayerPtr Reseeded(std::uint64_t seed) const override;

    LayerPtr Rebound(const LayerReplacements& replaced) const override;

    LayerPtr Rebased(const TerrainBase& base) const override;

    bool Holds(double x, double y, const Surface& surface = {}) const;

    CraterFeatures CratersOver(const RasterGrid& grid, double spacing) const override;

    BoulderFeatures BouldersOver(const RasterGrid& grid, double spacing,
                                 const Ground* ground) const override;

  protected:
    void ApplySamples(SampleBlock& samples, const LayerContext& context) const override;

  private:
    void ApplyToGrid(Raster<float>& heights, const LayerContext& context) const;
    void ApplyToPoints(SampleBlock& samples, const LayerContext& context) const;
    PixelWindow InnerWindow(const RasterGrid& grid, const Surface& surface) const;
    std::optional<RasterGrid> InnerGrid(const RasterGrid& grid, const Surface& surface) const;
    LayerPtr Confining(LayerPtr inner) const;

    std::shared_ptr<const Layer> m_inner;
    RegionShape m_shape;
    double m_feather;
    BlendShape m_blend;
};

namespace terraingen {

enum class BoulderRest : std::uint8_t {
    Face,  
    Side,  
    End,   
};

struct BoulderFacet {
    double azimuth = 0.0;
    double angle = 0.0;  
    double reach = 0.0;

    double HeightAt(const Vec2d& offset) const {
        const double along = offset.x * std::cos(azimuth) + offset.y * std::sin(azimuth);
        return (reach - along) * std::tan(angle);
    }

    bool operator==(const BoulderFacet& other) const {
        return azimuth == other.azimuth && angle == other.angle && reach == other.reach;
    }
};

struct Boulder {
    double x = 0.0;         
    double y = 0.0;         
    double diameter = 0.0;  
    double height = 0.0;
    double burial = 0.0;   
    double yaw = 0.0;      
    double lean = 0.0;     
    std::uint64_t id = 0;  
    BoulderRest rest = BoulderRest::Face;  
    double tilt = 0.0;         
    double tiltAzimuth = 0.0;  
    std::optional<double> ground{};
    bool model = false;
    double wear = 0.0;
    std::uint64_t parent = 0;
    std::uint32_t piece = 0;  
    std::array<BoulderFacet, 2> facets{};
    std::uint8_t facetCount = 0;  
    std::optional<std::uint64_t> shapeSeed{};

    double ExposedHeight() const {
        return height * (1.0 - burial);
    }

    double CutByFacets(const Vec2d& offset, double top) const {
        for (std::uint8_t k = 0; k < facetCount; ++k) {
            top = std::fmin(top, facets[k].HeightAt(offset));
        }
        return std::fmax(top, 0.0);
    }

    bool operator==(const Boulder& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y && diameter == other.diameter &&
               height == other.height && burial == other.burial && yaw == other.yaw &&
               lean == other.lean && id == other.id && rest == other.rest && tilt == other.tilt &&
               tiltAzimuth == other.tiltAzimuth && ground == other.ground && model == other.model &&
               wear == other.wear && parent == other.parent && piece == other.piece &&
               facets == other.facets && facetCount == other.facetCount &&
               shapeSeed == other.shapeSeed;
    }
};

class CraterCellCache;

struct BoulderAbundance {
    double background = 1.0;
    double ejecta = 0.0;
    double ejectaWear = 0.0;
    std::optional<double> exponent;

    bool operator==(const BoulderAbundance& other) const {
        return background == other.background && ejecta == other.ejecta &&
               ejectaWear == other.ejectaWear && exponent == other.exponent;
    }
};

struct UnresolvedCover {
    double mean = 0.0;      
    double variance = 0.0;  

    bool operator==(const UnresolvedCover& other) const {
        return mean == other.mean && variance == other.variance;
    }
};

class BoulderLayer final : public Layer, public BoulderPlacer, public MaterialSource {
  public:

                 TerrainBase base = {});

                 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const CraterLayer>> craters, TerrainBase base);

    BoulderList Boulders(const Bounds2d& region, double spacing = 0.0,
                         const Ground* ground = nullptr) const;

    BoulderAbundance AbundanceAt(double x, double y, const Ground* ground = nullptr) const;

    UnresolvedCover UnresolvedCoverAt(double x, double y, double spacing,
                                      const Ground* ground = nullptr) const;
    std::vector<UnresolvedCover> UnresolvedCoverOver(const RasterGrid& grid, double spacing,
                                                     const Ground* ground, unsigned threads) const;

    double MaxFeatureDiameter() const;

    const BoulderLayerOptions& Options() const {
        return m_options;
    }

    std::optional<TerrainBase> LayerBase() const override {
        return TerrainBase{m_surface, m_source};
    }

    double GroundReach(double spacing) const override;

    std::vector<const Layer*> Dependencies() const override {
        std::vector<const Layer*> layers;
        for (const std::shared_ptr<const CraterLayer>& craters : m_craters) {
            layers.push_back(craters.get());
        }
        return layers;
    }

    LayerPtr Reseeded(std::uint64_t seed) const override;

    LayerPtr Rebound(const LayerReplacements& replaced) const override;

    LayerPtr Rebased(const TerrainBase& base) const override;

    std::vector<BoulderModel> Models(const std::vector<Boulder>& boulders) const;

    BoulderFeatures BouldersOver(const RasterGrid& grid, double spacing,
                                 const Ground* ground) const override;

    MaterialClass Material() const override {
        return MaterialClass::Rock;
    }
    double MaterialCoverAt(double x, double y, const LayerContext& context) const override;
    Raster<double> MaterialCoverOver(const RasterGrid& grid,
                                     const LayerContext& context) const override;

  protected:

  private:
    enum class BoulderDraw : std::uint32_t { Keep, Pose, Wear, Settle, Abrade, Fragments };

    struct ThinnedCandidate {

        double density = 0.0;

    void ReadGround(Boulder& boulder, const Ground* ground) const;
    std::vector<Boulder> DrawBoulders(const CraterList& candidates, double spacing,

namespace terraingen {

struct BoulderPlacement {
    Vec3d scale{1.0, 1.0, 1.0};  
    RigidTransform pose{};       

    Vec3d Apply(const Vec3d& p) const {
        return pose.Apply({p.x * scale.x, p.y * scale.y, p.z * scale.z});
    }

    Vec3d Unapply(const Vec3d& p) const {
        const std::array<double, 9>& r = pose.rotation;
        const Vec3d d = p - pose.translation;
        return {(r[0] * d.x + r[3] * d.y + r[6] * d.z) / scale.x,
                (r[1] * d.x + r[4] * d.y + r[7] * d.z) / scale.y,
                (r[2] * d.x + r[5] * d.y + r[8] * d.z) / scale.z};
    }
};

TriangleMesh PlaceMesh(TriangleMesh mesh, const BoulderPlacement& placement);

template <typename Map>
std::pair<double, double> ZRange(const std::vector<Vec3d>& points, const Map& map) {
    double low = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
    double high = -low;
    for (const Vec3d& p : points) {
        const double z = map(p).z;
        low = std::fmin(low, z);
        high = std::fmax(high, z);
    }
    return {low, high};
}

struct BoulderModel {
    Boulder boulder;              
    std::uint64_t shapeSeed = 0;  
    std::shared_ptr<const BoulderShape> shape;  
    BoulderPlacement placement;                 
};

struct ValueRange {
    double min = 0.0;  
    double max = 0.0;  

    double Lerp(double u) const {
        return min + (max - min) * u;
    }

    bool operator==(const ValueRange& other) const {
        return min == other.min && max == other.max;
    }
};

// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause

#pragma once

#include "terraingen/geometry/surface.h"
#include "terraingen/noise/hash.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace terraingen {

class BandBuckets {
  public:
    explicit BandBuckets(const Surface& surface) : m_surface(&surface) {}

    void Add(int band, double size, const Vec2d& point, std::size_t n) {
        Band& entry = m_bands[band];
        if (entry.buckets.empty()) {
            entry.size = size;
        }
        entry.buckets[m_surface->Bucket(point, entry.size)].push_back(n);
    }

    std::vector<int> Bands() const {
        std::vector<int> bands;
        for (const auto& entry : m_bands) {
            bands.push_back(entry.first);
        }
        return bands;
    }

    bool Has(int band) const {
        return m_bands.count(band) > 0;
    }

    double Size(int band) const {
        return m_bands.at(band).size;
    }

    template <typename Visit>
    void ForEachAround(int band, const Vec2d& point, long long span, const Visit& visit) const {
        const auto found = m_bands.find(band);
        if (found == m_bands.end()) {
            return;
        }
        const Band& entry = found->second;
        const BucketIndex center = m_surface->Bucket(point, entry.size);
        const long long depth = m_surface->IsBody() ? span : 0;
        for (long long j = center.j - span; j <= center.j + span; ++j) {
            for (long long i = center.i - span; i <= center.i + span; ++i) {
                for (long long k = center.k - depth; k <= center.k + depth; ++k) {
                    const auto bucket = entry.buckets.find({i, j, k});
                    if (bucket != entry.buckets.end()) {
                        visit(bucket->second);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

  private:
    struct BucketHash {
        std::size_t operator()(const BucketIndex& key) const {
            return HashWords({static_cast<std::uint64_t>(key.i), static_cast<std::uint64_t>(key.j),
                              static_cast<std::uint64_t>(key.k)});
        }
    };
    struct Band {
        double size = 0.0;
        std::unordered_map<BucketIndex, std::vector<std::size_t>, BucketHash> buckets;
    };

    const Surface* m_surface;
    std::map<int, Band> m_bands;
};

}  // namespace terraingen

inline std::optional<double> UnlessNan(double value) {
    return std::isnan(value) ? std::nullopt : std::optional<double>(value);
}

struct Crater {
    double x = 0.0;         
    double y = 0.0;         
    double diameter = 0.0;  
    double ageGyr = 0.0;    
    std::uint64_t id = 0;   
    bool manual = false;
    std::optional<double> depth{};
    std::optional<double> rimHeight{};
    bool replace = false;

    Crater& AgeGyr(double gyr) {
        ageGyr = gyr;
        return *this;
    }
    Crater& Depth(double meters) {
        depth = meters;
        return *this;
    }
    Crater& RimHeight(double meters) {
        rimHeight = meters;
        return *this;
    }
    Crater& Replace(bool replaces = true) {
        replace = replaces;
        return *this;
    }

    bool operator==(const Crater& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y && diameter == other.diameter &&
               ageGyr == other.ageGyr && id == other.id && manual == other.manual &&
               depth == other.depth && rimHeight == other.rimHeight && replace == other.replace;
    }
    bool operator!=(const Crater& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

std::uint64_t ManualCraterId(double x, double y, double diameter);

inline Crater ManualCrater(double x, double y, double diameter) {
    Crater crater;
    crater.x = x;
    crater.y = y;
    crater.diameter = diameter;
    crater.manual = true;
    return crater;
}

constexpr std::uint32_t CraterKey(std::uint64_t id, std::uint32_t seed) {
    return HashWord64(id, seed);
}

class CraterList {
  public:
    CraterList() = default;

    CraterList(std::initializer_list<Crater> craters);

    std::size_t Size() const {
        return m_id.size();
    }

    bool Empty() const {
        return m_id.empty();
    }

    void Reserve(std::size_t count);

    void Append(const Crater& crater);

    void Append(const CraterList& other);

    Crater At(std::size_t index) const;

    const std::vector<double>& X() const {
        return m_x;
    }

    const std::vector<double>& Y() const {
        return m_y;
    }

    const std::vector<double>& Diameters() const {
        return m_diameter;
    }

    const std::vector<double>& AgesGyr() const {
        return m_ageGyr;
    }

    const std::vector<std::uint64_t>& Ids() const {
        return m_id;
    }

    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& Manual() const {
        return m_manual;
    }

    const std::vector<double>& Depths() const {
        return m_depth;
    }

    const std::vector<double>& RimHeights() const {
        return m_rimHeight;
    }

    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& Replace() const {
        return m_replace;
    }

    bool AnyReplace() const;

  private:
    std::vector<double> m_x;
    std::vector<double> m_y;
    std::vector<double> m_diameter;
    std::vector<double> m_ageGyr;
    std::vector<std::uint64_t> m_id;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> m_manual;
    std::vector<double> m_depth;
    std::vector<double> m_rimHeight;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> m_replace;
};

template <typename Keep> CraterList FilterCraters(const CraterList& craters, const Keep& keep) {
    CraterList kept;
    kept.Reserve(craters.Size());
    for (std::size_t n = 0; n < craters.Size(); ++n) {
        const Crater crater = craters.At(n);
        if (keep(n, crater)) {
            kept.Append(crater);
        }
    }
    return kept;
}

void AppendManualCraters(const CraterList& manual, CraterList& craters,
                         const std::function<bool(const Crater&)>& keep = {});

struct CraterSelection {
    double minDiameter = 0.0;                                      
    double maxDiameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();  
    double minAgeGyr = 0.0;                                        
    double maxAgeGyr = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();    
    bool manual = true;

    bool Includes(const Crater& crater) const;

    bool operator==(const CraterSelection& other) const {
        return minDiameter == other.minDiameter && maxDiameter == other.maxDiameter &&
               minAgeGyr == other.minAgeGyr && maxAgeGyr == other.maxAgeGyr &&
               manual == other.manual;
    }
    bool operator!=(const CraterSelection& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

using DiffusionAgeModel = std::function<double(double diameter, double ageGyr)>;

struct PowerLawDiffusivity {
    double coefficient = 1.0;  
    double exponent = 0.0;     
    double minDiameter = 0.0;  

    double Diffusivity(double diameter) const;
    double operator()(double diameter, double ageGyr) const;

    bool operator==(const PowerLawDiffusivity& other) const {
        return coefficient == other.coefficient && exponent == other.exponent &&
               minDiameter == other.minDiameter;
    }
    bool operator!=(const PowerLawDiffusivity& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

void ValidatePowerLawDiffusivity(const PowerLawDiffusivity& law);

class DiffusedProfile final : public CraterProfile {
  public:
    explicit DiffusedProfile(std::shared_ptr<const CraterProfile> fresh, double reachRadii = 3.0,
                             std::size_t cells = 600, std::size_t cacheTables = 64);

    double Height(double distance, double diameter, const CraterState& state) const override;

    double ReachRadii() const override {
        return m_reachRadii;
    }

    bool IsComplex(double diameter) const override {
        return m_fresh->IsComplex(diameter);
    }

    CraterMorphometry Morphometry(const CraterMorphometry& fresh, double diameter,
                                  double tau) const;

    double AgeAtDepthRatio(const CraterMorphometry& fresh, double diameter,
                           double depthRatio) const;

    const std::vector<double>& Ages() const;

    const CraterProfile& Fresh() const {
        return *m_fresh;
    }

    const CraterProfileKernel& Kernel() const {
        return m_kernel;
    }

    std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<float>> HeightTable(const CraterMorphometry& fresh,
                                                          double diameter) const;

  private:
    struct Key {
        double depthRatio;
        double rimHeightRatio;
        double diameter;
        bool operator==(const Key& other) const {
            return depthRatio == other.depthRatio && rimHeightRatio == other.rimHeightRatio &&
                   diameter == other.diameter;
        }
        bool operator!=(const Key& other) const {
            return !(*this == other);
        }
    };
    struct KeyHash {
        std::size_t operator()(const Key& key) const;
    };
    struct Table {
        std::vector<float> heights;  
        std::vector<CraterMorphometry> morphometry;
    };

    std::shared_ptr<const Table> CachedTable(const CraterMorphometry& fresh, double diameter) const;
    Table Solve(const CraterMorphometry& fresh, double diameter) const;

    std::shared_ptr<const CraterProfile> m_fresh;
    double m_reachRadii;
    std::size_t m_cells;
    std::shared_ptr<LruCache<Key, Table, KeyHash>> m_tables;
    std::uint64_t m_instance;  
    CraterProfileKernel m_kernel;
};

class DiffusionDegradation final : public DegradationModel {
  public:
    DiffusionDegradation(FreshMorphometry fresh, DiffusionAgeModel ages,
                         std::shared_ptr<const DiffusedProfile> profile);

    CraterState State(const Crater& crater) const override;

    CraterState WornState(const Crater& crater, double rate) const override;

    std::shared_ptr<const CraterProfile> RequiredProfile() const override {
        return m_profile;
    }

  private:
    FreshMorphometry m_fresh;
    DiffusionAgeModel m_ages;
    std::shared_ptr<const DiffusedProfile> m_profile;
};

}  // namespace terraingen

// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause

#pragma once

#include <functional>

namespace terraingen {

inline constexpr double kVisibilityDepthRatio = 0.04;

struct CraterMorphometry {
    double depthRatio = 0.0;      
    double rimHeightRatio = 0.0;  

    bool operator==(const CraterMorphometry& other) const {
        return depthRatio == other.depthRatio && rimHeightRatio == other.rimHeightRatio;
    }
    bool operator!=(const CraterMorphometry& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

struct CraterState {
    CraterMorphometry fresh;    
    CraterMorphometry current;  
    double diffusion = 0.0;

    double Freshness() const {
        return fresh.depthRatio > 0.0 ? current.depthRatio / fresh.depthRatio : 1.0;
    }

    bool operator==(const CraterState& other) const {
        return fresh == other.fresh && current == other.current && diffusion == other.diffusion;
    }
    bool operator!=(const CraterState& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

using FreshMorphometry = std::function<CraterMorphometry(double diameter)>;

}  // namespace terraingen

namespace terraingen {

using HeightSampler = std::function<float(double x, double y)>;

using HeightsSampler = std::function<void(Span<const Vec2d> points, Span<float> heights)>;

constexpr int kDatumLatticeSide = 7;

constexpr std::size_t kDatumLatticePoints =
    static_cast<std::size_t>(kDatumLatticeSide * kDatumLatticeSide);

inline double DatumLatticeOffset(int index, double fitRadius) {
    return fitRadius * ((2.0 * index + 1.0) / kDatumLatticeSide - 1.0);
}

template <typename Visit> void ForEachDatumPoint(double fitRadius, const Visit& visit) {
    for (int j = 0; j < kDatumLatticeSide; ++j) {
        const double dy = DatumLatticeOffset(j, fitRadius);
        for (int i = 0; i < kDatumLatticeSide; ++i) {
            const double dx = DatumLatticeOffset(i, fitRadius);
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy < fitRadius * fitRadius) {
                visit(static_cast<std::size_t>(j * kDatumLatticeSide + i), dx, dy);
            }
        }
    }
}

inline float SplitDifference(float a, float aLow, float b, float bLow) {
    return (a - b) + (aLow - bLow);
}

inline float KernelArcsineRatio(float s) {
    if (s < 0.25f) {
        const float s2 = s * s;
        return 1.0f + s2 * (1.0f / 6.0f +
                            s2 * (3.0f / 40.0f + s2 * (5.0f / 112.0f + s2 * (35.0f / 1152.0f))));
    }
    return atan2(s, sqrt(1.0f - s * s)) / s;
}

inline KernelOffset KernelFrameOffset(KERNEL_IN(CraterFrame) f, float dx, float dy, float dz) {
    KernelOffset offset;
    offset.dx = dx * f.eastX + dy * f.eastY + dz * f.eastZ;
    offset.dy = dx * f.northX + dy * f.northY + dz * f.northZ;
    if (f.sphereRadius > 0.0f) {
        const float chord = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
        const float arc = chord * KernelArcsineRatio(min(0.5f * chord / f.sphereRadius, 1.0f));
        const float across = sqrt(offset.dx * offset.dx + offset.dy * offset.dy);
        if (across > 0.0f) {
            offset.dx *= arc / across;
            offset.dy *= arc / across;
        } else {
            offset.dy = arc;
        }
    }
    return offset;
}

struct SplitPoint {
    float x;
    float xLow;
    float y;
    float yLow;
    float z;
    float zLow;
};

inline KernelOffset PlanarSplitOffset(KERNEL_IN(CraterRecord) c, KERNEL_IN(SplitPoint) p) {
    KernelOffset offset;
    offset.dx = SplitDifference(p.x, p.xLow, c.x, c.xLow);
    offset.dy = SplitDifference(p.y, p.yLow, c.y, c.yLow);
    return offset;
}

inline KernelOffset BodySplitOffset(KERNEL_IN(CraterFrame) f, KERNEL_IN(SplitPoint) p) {
    return KernelFrameOffset(f, SplitDifference(p.x, p.xLow, f.x, f.xLow),
                             SplitDifference(p.y, p.yLow, f.y, f.yLow),
                             SplitDifference(p.z, p.zLow, f.z, f.zLow));
}
