seed

integer, optional · default null

Varies the noise of every crater; unset follows the layer's seed.

texture: Gullies down fresh walls, textured ejecta and older relief buried under the ejecta; off unless an amplitude or mantling is set. wall_streaks

number · default 0.0

Amplitude of the radial gullies down a fresh crater's inner wall, as a share of its diameter; 0 adds none. Must not be negative.

wall_streak_width_radii

number · default 0.15

Width of the gullies across the wall, in crater radii. Must be positive.

ejecta

number · default 0.0

Amplitude of the hummocky, radially lineated ejecta around a fresh crater, as a share of the ejecta's thickness (McGetchin et al. 1973); 0 adds none. Must not be negative.

ejecta_lineation_radii

number · default 0.15

Width of the ejecta's lineations across, in crater radii at the rim. Must be positive.

mantling

number · default 0.0

Share of older relief buried under the ejecta at the rim, falling with their thickness; needs a datum. Must be from 0 to 1.

ejecta_reach_radii

number · default 3.0

How far ejecta texture and burial reach, in crater radii. Must be above 1.

min_freshness

number · default 0.5

Freshness (depth over fresh depth) at or below which gullies and ejecta texture are worn away. Must be from 0 to below 1.

seed

integer, optional · default null

Varies the texture of every crater; unset follows the layer's seed.

slope: Craters on sloping ground with floors offset downslope and rims lowered upslope; needs the plane datum. asymmetric

boolean · default false

Shapes craters asymmetrically along the slope of the ground beneath the layer; off keeps them the same on any slope.

seed

integer, optional · default null

Varies how far each crater's floor is offset; unset follows the layer's seed.

upslope_rim

number · default 0.0

Share of the raised rim and ejecta kept straight upslope; the rest returns toward the sides. Must be from 0 to 1.

full_slope_deg

number · default 5.0 · unit deg

Slope at which the asymmetry is complete, in degrees; it rises from none on level ground. Must be positive.

critical_gradient

number, optional · default null

Critical gradient Sc, rise over run, toward which downslope transport grows without bound: a crater on a regional gradient S wears 1 / (1 - (S / Sc)^2) times as fast (Roering et al. 1999). Unset wears craters alike on any slope; no lunar value is published. Must be positive.

max_wear_rate

number · default 10.0

Fastest a slope makes craters wear, over level ground: a numerical cap as S nears Sc. Must be at least 1.

floor_offset: How far the deepest point lies downslope of the center, in diameters, drawn per crater; below 0.23. kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

b

number · default 0.0

The uniform's upper bound, or the standard deviation (of the natural logarithm for a log-normal); unused for a constant.

min

number, optional · default null

Lower bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded below.

max

number, optional · default null

Upper bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded above, which normal and log-normal kinds do not allow.

edges

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the edges of the bins, at least two and strictly increasing; values are uniform within each bin. Empty for every other kind.

weights

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

terraces: Slump terraces on the walls of craters from the onset diameter, softening as they wear. enabled

boolean · default false

Steps the walls of large craters into slump terraces: benches and scarps between the floor and the rim crest.

seed

integer, optional · default null

Varies each crater's benches, the arcs they cover and how they wander; unset follows the layer's seed.

onset_diameter_m

number · default 20000.0 · unit m

Smallest terraced crater, in meters; 20 km on the Moon, where half of fresh mare craters are terraced, and about 8 km on Mars. Must be positive.

full_diameter_m

number · default 65000.0 · unit m

Diameter in meters from which every crater has its most benches, over most of its wall; above the onset diameter. Must be positive.

min_benches

integer · default 1

Benches at the onset diameter. Must be from 1 to 12.

max_benches

integer · default 4

Benches from the full diameter; complex lunar craters usually have more than 3. Must be from 1 to 12.

bench_slope_deg

number · default 3.0 · unit deg

Slope of a bench, in degrees; mapped lunar terraces slope under 5 degrees. Must be above 0 and below 45 deg.

scarp_share

number · default 0.25

Least share of each step's width the scarps take; steeper steps give them more, and the bench takes the rest. Must be above 0 and below 1.

scarp_slope_deg

number · default 35.0 · unit deg

Slope the scarps rise at, in degrees, above the bench slope; each step gives its scarps the share of its width that keeps them near it. Must be above 0 and below 60 deg.

arc_share

number · default 0.6

Share of the wall's circumference each bench covers at the onset diameter; it rises to 0.9 at the full diameter, and 1 gives benches all the way round. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

rim_variation

number · default 0.08

How far the bench radii wander around the rim, in crater radii. Must not be negative.

block_offset

number · default 0.6

How far each slump block's headscarp steps from its neighbors', as a share of the room between scarps. Must be from 0 to 1.

block_gaps

number · default 0.25

Share of slump blocks missing from each bench, breaking the benches into segments. Must be from 0 to below 1.

min_freshness

number · default 0.3

Freshness, current over fresh depth, below which the terraces are gone; they soften as the crater wears down to it. Must be from 0 to below 1.

peaks: Central peaks of complex craters built from massifs, lowering as the craters wear. enabled

boolean · default false

Builds the central peaks of complex craters from massifs: mountains clustered about the center in place of the profile's round dome.

seed

integer, optional · default null

Varies each crater's massifs and their noise; unset follows the layer's seed.

min_massifs

integer · default 1

Fewest massifs of a peak. Must be from 1 to 8.

max_massifs

integer · default 4

Most massifs of a peak. Must be from 1 to 8.

spread_radii

number · default 0.8

How far the lesser massifs' centers scatter from the crater's center, in peak base radii. Must be from 0 to 2.

elongation

number · default 2.0

Most aspect ratio of a massif's footprint; 1 keeps them round, larger makes ridges. Must be from 1 to 4.

chain_spread_deg

number · default 70.0 · unit deg

Spread of the lesser massifs' bearings about a chain through the center, in degrees: about 70 strings them across the floor, wide spreads scatter them around it into stars and crosses. Must be from 0 to 360 deg.

sharpness

number · default 0.6

How sharp the massifs' crests are: 0 domes, 1 spires. Must be from 0 to 1.

lopsidedness

number · default 0.5

How far each massif's summit sits off its center toward one flank. Must be from 0 to 1.

height_variation

number · default 0.5

How much lower than the main massif the others may be, as a share of its height. Must be from 0 to 1.

roughness

number · default 0.35

Ridged noise over the massifs, as a share of their height, carving spurs, gullies and lesser summits; worn peaks lose it. Must be from 0 to 1.

roughness_wavelength

number · default 0.35

Wavelength of the massifs' noise, in peak base radii. Must be positive.

warp

number · default 0.12

How far the noise warps the massifs' outlines, in peak base radii. Must be from 0 to 0.3.

height_scale

number · default 1.0

The massifs' height over the profile's peak height. Must be above 0 and at most 4.

width_scale

number · default 1.0

The massifs' spread and size over the profile's peak base. Must be above 0 and at most 3.

density_map: Map that sets the crater density point by point, scaling the density's size distribution to what it measures; unset keeps the density the same everywhere. measure

one of scale, count, areal_fraction · default "scale"

What the map's values measure.

min_diameter_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Smallest diameter the map measures, in meters; positive for a count or areal fraction. Must not be negative.

max_diameter_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Largest diameter the map measures, in meters, exclusive; unset for no limit. Must be positive.

area_unit

number · default 1.0 · unit m^2

Square meters per area unit of a count: 1 for per m^2, 1e6 for per km^2. Must be positive.

total

boolean · default true

The map counts every feature of its kind, including the secondaries thrown from a crater layer's craters and the boulders a layer throws out around craters, which are taken out of it first; off when it counts only what the layer generates.

periodic_longitude

The raster's x is longitude repeating every 360 degrees, so a map from 0 to 360 serves -180 to 180.

completeness: Where the manual craters are a complete catalog: the diameter in meters from which they stand in for generated craters, infinite or no value where there is no catalog. Unset keeps every generated crater. path

GeoTIFF read in the surface's coordinates, relative to the configuration's folder: meters on a plane, longitude and latitude in degrees on a sphere. Empty uses value.

The field everywhere when no path is given.

Band of the GeoTIFF read, from 0.

How the raster is interpolated: nearest or bilinear, which stay within the cells read.

scale

The raster's x is longitude repeating every 360 degrees, so a map from 0 to 360 serves -180 to 180.

replace_inherited_craters: Craters of a coarser level, such as a coarser run whose heights are the source, stamped again sharp with their IDs, ages, depths and rims where the source's upsampling softened them; null for none. path

string · default ""

Crater list of the coarser level, CSV or JSON as a crater_list output writes it (with attributes for the realized depths and rims), or a catalog of the craters a DEM holds; relative paths resolve against the configuration's folder. Required.

min_source_px

number, optional · default null · unit px

Source cells across from which a listed crater is stamped again sharp and generated craters are dropped; smaller ones are left to generation, which fills the gaps. Unset follows source_resolves_px; lower it to clean up the smaller craters a coarser run drew blurred into the source. Must be positive.

max_source_px

number, optional · default null · unit px

Source cells across from which listed craters are left as the source holds them, since interpolation barely softens them; unset stamps every one from min_source_px. Must be positive.

docs.title: boulders
docs.text:
Boulders scattered over the ground from a size distribution, in patches and around fresh craters, as relief or 3D models.

generate_random

boolean · default true

Draws random boulders from the size distribution, between craters and around them; off places only the manual boulders, and the sizes, coverage and ejecta go unused.

coverage

number, optional · default null

Golombek-Rapp k, the fraction of the ground covered by boulders, above 0 when generating random boulders; higher values give more boulders. Unset is 0.02. Only golombek_rapp sizes use it, so set it only with them. Must be from 0 to below 1.

qa

number, optional · default null · unit 1/m

Constant term of the Golombek-Rapp q = qa + qb / k, per meter; a larger q leaves fewer large boulders. Unset is 1.79. Only golombek_rapp sizes or ejecta sizes use it, so set it only with them.

qb

number, optional · default null · unit 1/m

Term of the Golombek-Rapp q = qa + qb / k divided by the coverage k, per meter; unset is 0.152, and it is used as qa is.

min_diameter_m

number · default 0.1 · unit m

Smallest boulder generated, in meters; lower values add many more small boulders. Must be positive.

max_diameter_m

number · default 5.861381645140288 · unit m

Largest boulder generated, in meters, exclusive; above the smallest. Must be positive.

sizes

boulder sizes · default {"type": "sp8023_intercrater", ...}

Size distribution of the boulders between craters, per m^2; patches and bedrock scale its density.

seed

integer · default 1

Seed of the boulders, their attributes and the patches; changing it gives a different boulder field of the same statistics.

ejecta_sizes

boulder sizes, optional · default null

Size distribution of the blocks at the rim of a fresh crater, per m^2; golombek_rapp uses the ejecta's coverage with qa and qb. Unset follows sizes.

extrapolate

boolean · default false

Lets the size distributions be evaluated outside their valid diameters, such as beyond a table's published ones; otherwise they must cover the boulder sizes.

bedrock_abundance

number · default 3.0

Boulder abundance on bedrock over that on soil, and in between in proportion; used with the exposure field. Must be positive.

bedrock_mean_size_m

number · default 1000.0 · unit m

With a density map, the side in meters of the squares bedrock is held to the map's mean over, so it gathers boulders without adding any; a GeoTIFF map uses its own cells. Must be positive.

min_height_ratio

number · default 0.4

Smallest boulder height over diameter; each boulder's is drawn uniformly between the two ratios. Must be positive.

max_height_ratio

number · default 0.6

Largest boulder height over diameter; at least the smallest. Must be positive.

min_burial

number · default 0.1

Smallest buried share of a boulder's height; each boulder's is drawn uniformly between the two shares. Must be from 0 to below 1.

max_burial

number · default 0.4

Largest buried share of a boulder's height; more burial leaves less of the boulder exposed. Must be from 0 to below 1.

max_lean_deg

number · default 14.896902673401405 · unit deg

Largest tilt of a boulder from the vertical, in degrees. Must not be negative.

side_share

number · default 0.0

Share of boulders resting on a side, their intermediate axis up, rather than on their broadest face. Must be from 0 to 1.

end_share

number · default 0.0

Share of boulders standing on an end, their long axis up; with side_share, at most 1. Must be from 0 to 1.

max_tilt_deg

number · default 0.0 · unit deg

Largest tilt of a boulder's up axis from the vertical in a random direction, after its lean, in degrees; tilts are spread evenly over that cap of directions. Must be from 0 to 180 deg.

follow_slope

boolean · default false

Settles each boulder on the slope of the ground beneath it before its tilt.

settle

docs.title: roughness
docs.text:
Fine roughness from octaves of noise, scaled to a given RMS slope over a baseline.

rms_slope

number, optional · default null

RMS slope, as rise over run, over the baseline when every octave is resolved; higher values give rougher ground. Unset is 0.15, or with estimate_from_source the source's RMS slope extrapolated to the baseline. Must be positive.

baseline_m

number · default 0.25 · unit m

Baseline the RMS slope is given over, in meters. Must be positive.

hurst

number, optional · default null

Hurst exponent: octave amplitudes grow as wavelength^hurst, so lower values put relatively more roughness at short wavelengths. Unset is 0.8, or with estimate_from_source the source's. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

estimate_from_source

boolean · default false

Fits unset rms_slope and hurst to the source's variogram at lags of 1 to 8 cells and continues it to the baseline; keep max_wavelength_m near the source's cell size. Needs a source with posts.

max_wavelength_m

number · default 16.0 · unit m

Wavelength of the longest octave, in meters. Must be positive.

min_wavelength_m

number · default 0.01 · unit m

Wavelength of the shortest octave, in meters; octaves halve from the longest down to it, spanning at most 40 octaves. Must be positive.

seed

integer · default 1

Seed of the noise; changing it gives a different pattern of the same roughness.

fade_px

list of number · default [...] · unit px

How octaves too fine to resolve at the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fade_shape

one of linear, smoothstep, smootherstep, gaussian · default "smoothstep"

Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

Every key with its default

    "type": "roughness",
    "rms_slope": null,
    "baseline_m": 0.25,
    "hurst": null,
    "estimate_from_source": false,
    "max_wavelength_m": 16.0,
    "min_wavelength_m": 0.01,
    "seed": 1,
    "fade_px": [
        2.0,
        4.0
    ],
    "fade_shape": "smoothstep"
}

docs.title: bedforms
docs.text:
Fields of wind-blown ripples or dunes added to the terrain.

wavelength_m

number · default 4.0 · unit m

Crest-to-crest spacing, in meters; each field's varies from 0.8 to 1.2 times it. Must be positive.

height_m

number · default 0.4 · unit m

Trough-to-crest height, in meters, scaled with each field's wavelength. Must not be negative.

wind_azimuth_deg

number · default 0.0 · unit deg

Direction the wind blows toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); crests lie across it.

azimuth_spread_deg

number · default 0.0 · unit deg

Largest difference of each field's wind from the azimuth, in degrees. Must not be negative.

lee_fraction

number · default 0.5

Share of a wavelength the lee face takes: 0.5 is symmetric, lower values give a steeper lee face. Must be above 0 and below 1.

sinuosity

number · default 0.5

How far a crest wanders along its length, in wavelengths; 0 gives straight crests. Must not be negative.

cover

number · default 0.9

Share of the ground under bedform fields; 0 gives no bedforms. Must be from 0 to 0.9.

field_size_m

number · default 100.0 · unit m

Typical width of a bedform field, in meters. Must be positive.

seed

integer · default 1

Seed of the fields and their crests; changing it gives a different layout of the same statistics.

exposure_spacing_m

number · default 1.0 · unit m

Spacing in meters the ground is read at for the exposure field. Must be positive.

fade_px

list of number · default [...] · unit px

How bedforms too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fade_shape

one of linear, smoothstep, smootherstep, gaussian · default "smoothstep"

Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

source_resolves_px

number, optional · default 4.0 · unit px

Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the bedforms, by their wavelength: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

exposure: Leaves out fields whose centers lie on bedrock, the likelier the barer the ground, as sand settles in lows; unset disables it. reach_m

number · default 12.0 · unit m

Distance in meters around a point at which its surroundings are read, to tell rises from lows. Must be positive.

rise_soil

number · default 0.01

Height above the surroundings, as a share of the reach, at or below which the ground is soil.

rise_boulder

number · default 0.035

Height above the surroundings, as a share of the reach, at or above which the ground is bedrock; above the soil threshold.

slope_soil

number · default 0.2

Slope, as rise over run, at or under which soil holds.

slope_boulder

number · default 0.4

Slope, as rise over run, at or over which no soil holds and the ground is bedrock; above the soil threshold.

floor_cover

number · default 0.0

Share of level ground that is bedrock too, in noise patches, as on a swept lava floor; 0 for none. Must be from 0 to below 1.

floor_patch_m

number · default 60.0 · unit m

Width of the bedrock patches on level ground, in meters. Must be positive.

seed

integer · default 0

Seed of the bedrock patches on level ground.

docs.text:
Scales and shifts the heights so far, for vertical exaggeration or a datum shift.

scale

number · default 1.0

Factor every height so far is multiplied by, as for vertical exaggeration.

offset_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Meters added to every height after scaling, to shift the datum.

docs.title: clamp
docs.text:
Clamps the heights so far between optional bounds, to flatten a basin floor or cap peaks.

min_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Lowest height kept, in meters; lower heights are raised to it, flattening basin floors. Unset leaves heights unbounded below.

max_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Highest height kept, in meters; higher heights are lowered to it, capping peaks. Unset leaves heights unbounded above.

Every key with its default

    "type": "clamp",
    "min_m": null,
    "max_m": null
}

docs.title: masked
docs.text:
Another layer applied only inside a rectangle, circle or polygon, feathered outside it: to confine craters to an area or flatten a landing pad.

shape

mask shapes · default {"type": "rectangle", ...}

Area the inner layer is applied in: a rectangle, a circle or a polygon.

feather_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Distance in meters outside the shape over which the inner layer fades back to the unchanged height; 0 gives a hard edge. Must not be negative.

blend

one of linear, smoothstep, smootherstep, gaussian · default "smoothstep"

Curve of the fade across the feather.

layer

layers · default {"type": "noise", ...}

Layer applied only inside the shape. A crater layer here does not count as the crater layer for later boulder ejecta or secondaries.

docs.title: secondaries
docs.text:
Secondary craters around the craters of the last crater layer before this one, after Singer et al. (2020).

seed

integer · default 0

Seed the secondaries are drawn with; changing it gives a different field of the same statistics.

onset_count

number, optional · default null

Secondaries at least count_fraction primary diameters across, in an area the size of the primary at the onset range; the sources give sizes, not numbers. Must be positive. Required.

count_fraction

number · default 0.01

Size, as a fraction of the primary's diameter, from which the onset count counts secondaries. Must be positive.

size_slope

number · default 4.0

Cumulative size slope of the secondaries, their number falling as d^-slope; higher values give relatively more small secondaries. Must be positive.

min_diameter_m

number · default 1.0 · unit m

Smallest secondary generated, in meters. Must be positive.

max_diameter_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Largest secondary generated, in meters; unset has no limit beyond Singer et al.'s largest secondary at each range. Must be positive.

outer_range

number, optional · default null

How far secondaries reach, in primary diameters from its center; unset uses the longest typical ray of Elliott et al. (2018). Must be positive.

min_primary_diameter_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Smallest diameter, in meters, of primary craters that throw secondaries. Must not be negative.

max_primary_diameter_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Largest diameter, in meters, of primary craters that throw secondaries; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

min_age_gyr

number · default 0.0 · unit Gyr

Youngest age, in Gyr, of primary craters that throw secondaries. Must not be negative.

max_age_gyr

number, optional · default null · unit Gyr

Oldest age, in Gyr, of primary craters that throw secondaries; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

manual

boolean · default true

Lets manual primary craters throw secondaries too; otherwise only generated and replacing ones do.

cell_size_factor

number · default 16.0

Side of the polar cells secondaries are drawn in, as a multiple of each size band's largest diameter. Must be positive.

source_resolves_px

number, optional · default 4.0 · unit px

Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the secondaries, by their diameter: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

depth_ratio

number · default 0.11

Depth over diameter every secondary is given, with no wear by age; lower values give shallower secondaries. Must be positive.

morphometry

one of lunar, mars · default "lunar"

Published fits whose fresh crater rim the secondaries are shaped with.

rays: Secondaries gathered into rays and clumped along them; off by default. enabled

boolean · default false

Gathers secondaries into their primary's rays and clumps them along each ray, as radial chains and clusters; off spreads them evenly.

share

number · default 0.7

Share of secondaries in rays; the rest stay spread evenly. Illustrative. Must be from 0 to 1.

min_half_angle_deg

number · default 2.0 · unit deg

Narrowest half width of a ray, in degrees, so rays widen with range beyond their width near the primary. Illustrative. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

clustering

number · default 0.8

How strongly secondaries clump along a ray: 0 spreads them evenly along it, 1 puts them only in clumps. Illustrative. Must be from 0 to 1.

cluster_spacing

number · default 0.15

Typical spacing of clumps along a ray, in natural log of range; smaller values give shorter, more frequent clumps. Illustrative. Must be positive.

layout: The rays; give a crater albedo layer's rays the same layout for bright rays over the secondaries. seed

integer · default 0

Seed of the rays' directions; layers with the same layout share the same rays.

count: Number of rays of a crater, drawn per crater and rounded; from 0 to 64. kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

b

number · default 0.0

The uniform's upper bound, or the standard deviation (of the natural logarithm for a log-normal); unused for a constant.

min

number, optional · default null

Lower bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded below.

max

number, optional · default null

Upper bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded above, which normal and log-normal kinds do not allow.

edges

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the edges of the bins, at least two and strictly increasing; values are uniform within each bin. Empty for every other kind.

weights

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

width_deg: Angle in degrees a ray spans 2 radii from the center, drawn per ray, within (0, 180). kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

b

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

shapes: Secondaries stretched toward their primary; round by default. elongated_share

number · default 0.0

Share of secondaries stretched along the line back to their primary; 0 keeps them round. Must be from 0 to 1.

ellipticity: Long over short axis of an elongated secondary near the primary, drawn per secondary; at least 1, falling to 1 at the outer range. kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

docs.title: dunes
docs.text:
Wind-blown dunes added to the terrain: isolated barchans or domes, or fields of transverse, barchanoid or linear crests, with slip faces and optional ripples on them.

shape

one of barchan, dome, transverse, barchanoid, linear · default "barchan"

The kind of dune.

wind_azimuth_deg

number · default 0.0 · unit deg

Direction the wind blows toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body); slip faces face it.

azimuth_spread_deg

number · default 0.0 · unit deg

Largest difference of each barchan or dome's wind from the azimuth, in degrees. Must not be negative.

slip_face_angle_deg

number · default 32.0 · unit deg

Slope of the lee slip faces, in degrees: the sand's angle of repose. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

stoss_slope_deg

number · default 10.0 · unit deg

Mean slope of the windward faces, in degrees; below the slip face angle. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

stoss_exponent

number · default 3.0

Exponent alpha of the cos^alpha windward profile of dunes; higher is blunter. Must be positive.

dome_exponent

number · default 1.8

Exponent alpha of the cos^alpha profile of domes. Must be positive.

lattice_spacing_m

number · default 129.0 · unit m

Barchans and domes: side of the lattice cells, each holding at most one dune, in meters. Must be positive.

density

number · default 0.5

Barchans and domes: chance a cell holds a dune. Must be from 0 to 1.

width_m

number · default 50.0 · unit m

Barchans and domes: mean width, horn to horn, in meters. Must be positive.

width_spread

number · default 0.3

Barchans and domes: each width varies from (1 - spread) to (1 + spread) times the mean. Must be from 0 to below 1.

min_width_m

number · default 15.0 · unit m

Barchans: width in meters below which a dune is a dome without a slip face, blending into barchans up to 1.5 times it. Must not be negative.

height_ratio

number · default 0.06666666666666667

Barchans and domes: height over width. Must be positive.

horn_length

number · default 9.1

Barchans: how far the horns reach downwind of the crest, in dune heights. Must not be negative.

dome_length

number · default 2.0

Domes: length along the wind over width. Must be positive.

wavelength_m

number · default 550.0 · unit m

Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: crest-to-crest spacing, in meters. Must be positive.

height_m

number · default 20.0 · unit m

Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: crest height, in meters. Must not be negative.

sinuosity

number · default 0.3

Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: how far a crest wanders along its length, in wavelengths. Must not be negative.

defects

number · default 0.3

Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: share of the height that varies along crests, lowering and ending some. Must be from 0 to 1.

defect_density

number · default 0.0 · unit 1/m

Transverse, barchanoid and linear dunes: pairs of crest ends per meter of crest, so crests break into segments about 1 / defect_density long; 0 for none. Olympia Undae: 0.0027 (Ewing et al. 2010). Must not be negative.

flank_slope_deg

number · default 20.0 · unit deg

Linear dunes: mean slope of both flanks, in degrees. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

seed

integer · default 1

Seed of the dunes and ripples; changing it gives a different layout of the same statistics.

anchor_x

number · default 0.0

On a body, the longitude in degrees of the point whose tangent frame the dunes are laid out in; they are true to scale near it and absent on the far hemisphere.

anchor_y

number · default 0.0

On a body, the latitude in degrees of the anchor.

fade_px

list of number · default [...] · unit px

How dunes too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples across their width or wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fade_shape

one of linear, smoothstep, smootherstep, gaussian · default "smoothstep"

Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

source_resolves_px

number, optional · default 4.0 · unit px

Source cells across from which the source's data already holds the dunes, their ripples and grainflows, by their width or crest wavelength, ripple wavelength and narrowest lobe: only smaller ones are added, each raster of a chain giving its own limit. Ignored on synthetic sources and where no raster has data; null adds them all. Must be positive.

ripples: Ripples superposed on the dunes; unset for none. wavelength_m

number · default 2.1 · unit m

Crest-to-crest spacing of the ripples on flat sand, in meters. Must be positive.

height_m

number · default 0.2 · unit m

Trough-to-crest height of the ripples on flat sand, in meters. Must not be negative.

lee_fraction

number · default 0.5

Share of a ripple wavelength the lee face takes: 0.5 is symmetric, lower values give a steeper lee face. Must be above 0 and below 1.

sinuosity

number · default 0.3

How far a ripple crest wanders along its length, in wavelengths. Must not be negative.

slope_coupling

number · default 1.0

How strongly the dune's slope turns and tightens the ripples: they shorten on steep lee faces and turn on the flanks; 0 keeps them straight across the wind. Must not be negative.

interdune_cover

number · default 0.0

Share of the ripple height kept on the ground between dunes. Must be from 0 to 1.

defect_density

number · default 0.0 · unit 1/m

Forked crests (Y-junctions): pairs of crest ends per meter of crest, as measured on dune fields (Ewing et al. 2010); 0 for none. Mars large ripples: 0.099. Must not be negative.

flank_straightening

number · default 0.0

How far crests straighten off the stoss: 1 keeps the sinuosity on flat sand and stoss slopes and takes it away on flanks and lee slopes, as Martian large ripples do. Must be from 0 to 1.

fade_px

docs.title: pavement
docs.text:
Fractured bedrock: polygonal plates, each tilted and stepped, parted by cracks or raised ridges, split again by finer octaves of cracks; lays bedrock over the material map.

plate_size_m

number · default 1.0 · unit m

Mean plate width, in meters. Must be positive.

jitter

number · default 1.0

How far plate centers stray from a square lattice; 0 gives square plates. Must be from 0 to 1.

warp

number · default 0.15

Bend and roughness of the plate edges, in plate sizes. Must not be negative.

crack_width_m

number · default 0.05 · unit m

Width of the cracks between plates, in meters. Must be positive.

crack_depth_m

number · default 0.05 · unit m

Depth of the cracks, or height of the ridges when raised, in meters. Must not be negative.

raised

boolean · default false

Whether plates are parted by raised ridges instead of cracks.

edge_rounding_m

number · default 0.02 · unit m

Width of the rounded shoulder beside each crack, in meters. Must not be negative.

max_tilt_deg

number · default 2.8647889756541165 · unit deg

Largest tilt of a plate, in degrees. Must be from 0 to below 90 deg.

max_step_m

number · default 0.03 · unit m

Largest height offset of a plate, up or down, in meters. Must not be negative.

octaves

integer · default 1

Crack octaves: each finer octave splits every plate again, its cracks ending at the plate's edges. Must be from 1 to 8.

lacunarity

number · default 2.0

Plate size ratio between octaves. Must be above 1.

gain

number · default 0.5

Ratio of crack width, depth, rounding, tilt and step between octaves. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

seed

integer · default 1

Seed of the plates.

exposure_spacing_m

number · default 1.0 · unit m

Spacing in meters the ground is read at for the exposure field. Must be positive.

anchor_x

number · default 0.0

On a body, the longitude in degrees of the point whose tangent frame the plates are laid out in.

anchor_y

number · default 0.0

On a body, the latitude in degrees of the anchor.

fade_px

list of number · default [...] · unit px

How plates and cracks too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples across them. Each must not be negative.

fade_shape

one of linear, smoothstep, smootherstep, gaussian · default "smoothstep"

Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

exposure: Shows plates only where the ground beneath is bare bedrock, fading out over soil; unset shows them everywhere. reach_m

number · default 12.0 · unit m

Distance in meters around a point at which its surroundings are read, to tell rises from lows. Must be positive.

rise_soil

number · default 0.01

Height above the surroundings, as a share of the reach, at or below which the ground is soil.

rise_boulder

number · default 0.035

Height above the surroundings, as a share of the reach, at or above which the ground is bedrock; above the soil threshold.

slope_soil

number · default 0.2

Slope, as rise over run, at or under which soil holds.

slope_boulder

number · default 0.4

Slope, as rise over run, at or over which no soil holds and the ground is bedrock; above the soil threshold.

floor_cover

number · default 0.0

Share of level ground that is bedrock too, in noise patches, as on a swept lava floor; 0 for none. Must be from 0 to below 1.

floor_patch_m

number · default 60.0 · unit m

Width of the bedrock patches on level ground, in meters. Must be positive.

seed

integer · default 0

Seed of the bedrock patches on level ground.

docs.title: strata
docs.text:
Layered rock: the ground beneath terraced into dipping beds, each a flat bench below a cliff, so hills become stepped buttes and mesas; lays bedrock over the cliffs.

bed_thickness_m

number · default 2.0 · unit m

Mean thickness of a bed, in meters. Must be positive.

thickness_variation

number · default 0.4

How far each bed boundary strays from even spacing, in bed thicknesses. Must be from 0 to below 1.

dip_deg

number · default 0.0 · unit deg

Dip of the beds from horizontal, in degrees. Must be from 0 to below 90 deg.

dip_azimuth_deg

number · default 0.0 · unit deg

Direction the beds dip toward, in degrees counter-clockwise from +x (local east on a body).

sharpness

number · default 4.0

How sharply each bed is cut into a flat bench and a cliff; 1 leaves the ground as it is. Must be at least 1.

strength

number · default 1.0

Share of the terracing applied. Must be from 0 to 1.

cliff_share

number · default 0.3

Share of each bed's height, at its top, laid as bedrock in the material map. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

seed

integer · default 1

Seed of the bed boundaries.

anchor_x

number · default 0.0

On a body, the longitude in degrees of the point whose tangent frame the dip is measured in.

anchor_y

number · default 0.0

On a body, the latitude in degrees of the anchor.

hard_share

number · default 1.0

Share of the beds that are hard rock: hard beds form benches and cliffs of bedrock, soft beds slopes cut at soft_sharpness without bedrock. Must be from 0 to 1.

soft_sharpness

number · default 1.0

How sharply soft beds are cut into benches and slopes; 1 leaves them as they are. Must be at least 1.

docs.title: sand_shadow
docs.text:

docs.title: spectral_continuation
docs.text:
Detail finer than the source continuing its measured power-law spectrum to shorter wavelengths with random phases, as sparse Gabor noise: an alternative to diamond-square upsampling without lattice artifacts.

pixel_size_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Cell size of the source in meters; the detail starts at twice it. Unset uses the source's cell size. Must be positive.

slope

number, optional · default null

Spectral slope beta of the radially averaged power spectrum, P(f) ~ f^-beta: beta = 2 H + 2 for Hurst exponent H. Unset fits it to the source. Must be from 2 to 4.

octave_rms_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

RMS height in meters the power law holds at wavelengths from one to two source pixels. Unset fits it to the source. Must not be negative.

fit_min_pixels

number · default 4.0

Shortest wavelength, in source pixels, the source's spectrum is fitted over. Must be at least 2.

fit_max_pixels

number · default 0.0

Longest wavelength, in source pixels, the source's spectrum is fitted over; 0 for a quarter of the window the spectrum is measured on (at most 512 cells a side). Must not be negative.

min_wavelength_m

number · default 0.05 · unit m

Shortest wavelength of the detail in meters; the detail spans the wavelengths from twice the source's pixel size down to it. Must be positive.

taper_octaves

number · default 1.0

Octaves above the source's Nyquist frequency over which the detail fades in, so it adds nothing at wavelengths the source resolves. Must be positive.

seed

integer · default 1

Seed of the detail; changing it gives a different pattern of the same spectrum.

fade_px

list of number · default [...] · unit px

How wavelengths too fine for the sample spacing fade out, by samples per wavelength. Each must not be negative.

fade_shape

one of linear, smoothstep, smootherstep, gaussian · default "smoothstep"

Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

docs.title: Upsampling
docs.text:
Chosen by "type" in upsampling.

Type Description nearest The value of the nearest cell center: blocky, but never mixes values. bilinear Linear in each axis over the four surrounding cells. cubic Keys cubic convolution (a = -0.5) over the sixteen surrounding cells: smooth, for upscaling DEMs. catmull_rom Another name for cubic: the Catmull-Rom spline is the same kernel. lanczos3 The three-lobe Lanczos kernel over the 36 surrounding cells: sharper than cubic, with slight ringing at steps. cubic_bspline The cubic B-spline over the sixteen surrounding cells: the smoothest, but it smooths the cells themselves. diamond_square Random midpoint displacement: each level halves the node spacing down to the sample spacing, adding fractal detail without changing the posts.

docs.title: diamond_square
docs.text:
Random midpoint displacement: each level halves the node spacing down to the sample spacing, adding fractal detail without changing the posts.

fractal_dimension

number, optional · default null

Fractal dimension, 2 smooth and 3 rough: each square or diamond step scales the displacement by 2^-((3 - F) / 2). Unset estimates it from the median height differences of the posts at lags of 1 to 8 posts. Must be from 2 to 3.

scale_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Displacement standard deviation in meters at the posts' last step; unset estimates it per fit_window_px window. Must not be negative.

fit_window_px

integer · default 32 · unit px

Side in posts of the overlapping windows, centered every half side, that an unset scale_m is fitted over; each node's scale is bilinear between the windows around it. 0 fits one scale to a sample of the posts; else at least 4. Must be from 0 to 1024 px.

interp

one of bilinear, catmull_rom · default "bilinear"

How new nodes are filled from the coarser ones and samples read between the finest nodes.

min_pixel_size_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Finest node spacing in meters the posts are refined to; 0 refines down to the sample spacing. Must not be negative.

seed

integer · default 1

Seed of the displacements.

docs.title: Crater densities
docs.text:
Chosen by "type" in density, distributions.

Type Description power_law A cumulative power law, N(>=D) = coefficient D^-exponent per m^2 with D in meters. piecewise_power_law A cumulative distribution made of power-law segments over diameter ranges. tabulated A cumulative distribution from a table of diameters and counts N(>=D), in units you choose. production_surface The craters a production function leaves on a surface of a given age, scaled by a chronology, with no erosion; cap it with an equilibrium in a minimum. minimum The least of several densities at each diameter, such as a production surface capped by an equilibrium. trask The Trask (1966) lunar equilibrium density, N(>=D) = 10^-1.1 D^-2. hartmann The Hartmann (1984) lunar equilibrium density, N(>=D) = 10^-1.14 D^-1.83 per km^2 with D in km. moore Moore's terrain-specific crater distributions for Lunar Roving Vehicle trafficability. viper The VIPER environmental specification crater density, as synthterrain uses it; kept for comparison with synthterrain. piecewise_uniform Counts per m^2 in diameter bands, each with diameters spread uniformly across it; none outside the bands.

docs.title: Crater ages
docs.text:
Chosen by "type" in ages.

Type Description uniform Ages uniform over one lifetime for every diameter, so freshness is uniform between 0 and 1. fresh Every crater is fresh, with age and lifetime zero. steady_state Crater ages where small craters are in equilibrium: a crater lasts until the production rate replaces the equilibrium density, or the surface's age, with ages drawn from the chronology's formation rate. freshness Ages from a freshness f between 0 and 1 drawn per crater, age = (1 - f) lifetime, with one lifetime for every diameter; freshness stands for age as in degree-of-freshness dating (Pohn and Offield 1970; Trang et al.

docs.text:

docs.title: steady_state
docs.text:
Crater ages where small craters are in equilibrium: a crater lasts until the production rate replaces the equilibrium density, or the surface's age, with ages drawn from the chronology's formation rate.

age_gyr

number · default 3.5 · unit Gyr

Age of the surface in Gyr; it caps every crater's lifetime, so larger craters on an older surface can be older. Must be from 0 to 4.6 Gyr.

production

one of neukum, extended_neukum, ivanov · default "extended_neukum"

Production function whose rate, with the equilibrium, sets how long small craters last.

equilibrium

one of trask, hartmann · default "hartmann"

Equilibrium density that, with the production rate, sets how long small craters last before they are erased.

chronology

one of neukum, ivanov · default "neukum"

Chronology whose formation rate the craters' ages are drawn from.

Every key with its default

docs.title: freshness
docs.text:
Ages from a freshness f between 0 and 1 drawn per crater, age = (1 - f) lifetime, with one lifetime for every diameter; freshness stands for age as in degree-of-freshness dating (Pohn and Offield 1970; Trang et al. 2015).

lifetime_gyr

number · default 1.0 · unit Gyr

Lifetime in Gyr of every crater: freshness 0 is this old, 1 is new; crater albedo such as ray fading reads these ages. Must be positive.

freshness: Distribution each crater's freshness is drawn from, also clamped to 0 to 1: 1 is fresh, 0 at the end of its lifetime; with freshness degradation, depth and rim scale with it. kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

b

number · default 0.0

The uniform's upper bound, or the standard deviation (of the natural logarithm for a log-normal); unused for a constant.

min

number, optional · default null

Lower bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded below.

max

number, optional · default null

Upper bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded above, which normal and log-normal kinds do not allow.

edges

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the edges of the bins, at least two and strictly increasing; values are uniform within each bin. Empty for every other kind.

weights

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

Every key with its default 
{
    "type": "freshness",
    "lifetime_gyr": 1.0,
    "freshness": {
        "kind": "uniform",
        "a": 0.0,
        "b": 1.0,
        "min": 0.0,
        "max": 1.0,
        "edges": [],
        "weights": []
    }
}

docs.title: diffusion
docs.text:
Wears craters down by topographic diffusion, from each crater's diameter and age.

diffusivity

one of matched, fassett_2022_hartmann, fassett_2022_trask, fassett_thomson_2014, fassett_thomson_2014_calibration, power_law · default "matched"

Model of the diffusion age each crater has from its diameter and age. The named fits are lunar; matched follows any steady-state ages, such as Martian ones from Ivanov's production function.

reach_radii

number · default 3.0

Distance from the center, in crater radii, out to which the diffused profile is solved and held at 0; at least the fresh profile's reach.

power_law: The diffusivity used when the diffusivity model is power_law. coefficient

number · default 1.0 · unit m^2/Myr

Diffusivity of a 1 km crater, in m^2/Myr; higher values wear craters down faster. Must be positive.

exponent

number · default 0.0

Exponent of the diameter in coefficient (D / 1 km)^exponent; 0 gives the same diffusivity for every crater size.

min_diameter_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Diameter in meters below which the diffusivity is held at its value at this diameter. Must not be negative.

docs.title: synthetic
docs.text:
A base color in hue, saturation and value, each varied by noise: an albedo for terrain without data.

rgb

boolean · default false

Gives three bands, red, green and blue, from the color; off gives one band of the value alone, ignoring hue and saturation.

hue_deg

number · default 0.0 · unit deg

Hue of the base color in degrees, wrapping around; used with rgb only.

saturation

number · default 0.0

Saturation of the base color, 0 for gray; used with rgb only. Must be from 0 to 1.

value

number · default 0.11

Reflectance of the brightest band; the one band's value without rgb. Higher values give a brighter surface. Must be from 0 to 1.

hue_noise_deg[]: Noise layers whose sum in degrees is added to the hue; used with rgb only. Holds 0 to 8 items. enabled

boolean · default true

Includes this layer in the stack; disabled layers are skipped.

basis

one of perlin, simplex, value, worley_f1, worley_f2, worley_f2_minus_f1, voronoi · default "perlin"

Single-octave noise the fractal is built from.

fractal

one of fbm, ridged, billow, hybrid_multifractal · default "fbm"

How the octaves of the basis noise are combined.

blend

one of add, max, min, mask · default "add"

How this layer combines with the height of the layers before it; the first enabled layer sets the height instead.

seed

integer · default 0

Seed of the noise; changing it gives a different pattern of the same character.

wavelength_m

number · default 1000.0 · unit m

Wavelength of the first, broadest octave, in meters; sets the size of the largest features. Must be positive.

amplitude

number, optional · default null

Largest value of the layer above or below 0, in what its stack varies: relative brightness, saturation or degrees of hue. Required.

octaves

integer · default 8

Number of octaves; each one adds detail at a shorter wavelength. Must be from 1 to 32.

lacunarity

number · default 2.0

Frequency ratio between successive octaves. Must be above 1.

gain

number · default 0.5

Weight ratio between successive octaves; higher values give rougher terrain. Unused when the Hurst exponent is set. Must be positive.

hurst

number, optional · default null

Hurst exponent that sets the octave gain to lacunarity^-hurst: near 1 is smooth, lower is rougher at short baselines. Unset uses the gain.

offset

number · default 1.0

Ridge offset of the ridged and hybrid multifractal types. Must be positive.

warp_amplitude_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Domain warp displacement in meters, which bends the noise into swirled shapes; 0 disables warping. Must not be negative.

warp_wavelength_m

number · default 500.0 · unit m

Wavelength of the warp field, in meters. Must be positive.

docs.title: raster
docs.text:
Albedo read from one or three bands of a GeoTIFF in the terrain's projection, such as an orbital albedo map.

path

string · default ""

GeoTIFF albedo map in the terrain's projected coordinates; relative paths resolve against the configuration's folder. Required.

bands

list of integer · default [...]

Bands of the file to read, counting from 0: one for a single albedo band, or three for red, green and blue. Holds 1 or 3 items.

scale

number, optional · default null

Factor each sample is multiplied by, replacing the band's scale from the file's GDAL metadata, as for maps stored as integers. Unset keeps the file's.

offset

number, optional · default null

Added to each scaled sample, replacing the band's offset from the file's GDAL metadata. Unset keeps the file's.

resampling

one of nearest, bilinear, cubic, catmull_rom, lanczos3, cubic_bspline · default "cubic"

Interpolation used to sample the map at the terrain's points.

detail: Fractal detail below the map's resolution, continuing the map's own measured roughness to finer scales. enabled

boolean · default true

Adds fractal detail below the map's resolution; off leaves the interpolated map as it is.

seed

integer · default 0

Seed of the detail noise; changing it gives a different pattern of the same roughness.

octaves

integer · default 4

Octaves of detail, from half the map's cell size down, each half the wavelength of the one before. Must be from 1 to 16.

scale

number · default 1.0

Factor on the RMS of every octave; 0 adds no detail, higher values give a more mottled albedo. Must not be negative.

hurst

number, optional · default null

Hurst exponent used instead of the one measured from the map; lower values keep more contrast at fine scales. Unset uses the measured one. Must be from 0 to 1.

fade_px

list of number · default [...] · unit px

How octaves of detail too fine for the sample spacing fade out. Each must not be negative.

fade_shape

one of linear, smoothstep, smootherstep, gaussian · default "smoothstep"

Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

Every key with its default 
{
    "type": "raster",
    "path": "",
    "bands": [
        0
    ],
    "scale": null,
    "offset": null,
    "resampling": "cubic",
    "detail": {
        "enabled": true,
        "seed": 0,
        "octaves": 4,
        "scale": 1.0,
        "hurst": null,
        "fade_px": [
            2.0,
            4.0
        ],
        "fade_shape": "smoothstep"
    }
}

docs.title: Albedo layers
docs.text:
Chosen by "type" in layers.

Type Description craters Bright ejecta, interiors and rays of the craters of a crater layer, fading with crater age. splotches Dark and bright splotches that secondary impacts of loose regolith leave over the whole surface, after Speyerer et al. blast_zones Brighter zones of regolith around landers scoured by their descent engines, after Clegg et al. rocks Rock brighter than the regolith: the boulders of boulder layers where resolved, and a speckle of the share of each sample covered by those too small to resolve. slopes Steep ground kept immature and bright by regolith moving downslope, after Ikeda et al.

docs.title: craters
docs.text:
Bright ejecta, interiors and rays of the craters of a crater layer, fading with crater age.

crater_layer

integer, optional · default null

Which top-level crater layer's craters to brighten, counting from 0; unset uses every top-level crater layer.

seed

integer · default 0

Seed of which craters get bright material, their rays and their impacts; changing it gives a different pattern of the same statistics.

min_diameter_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Smallest diameter, in meters, of craters given bright material. Must not be negative.

max_diameter_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Largest diameter, in meters, of craters given bright material; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

min_age_gyr

number · default 0.0 · unit Gyr

Youngest age, in Gyr, of craters given bright material. Must not be negative.

max_age_gyr

number, optional · default null · unit Gyr

Oldest age, in Gyr, of craters given bright material; unset has no upper limit. Must not be negative.

manual

boolean · default true

Gives manual craters bright material too; otherwise only generated and replacing craters have it.

share

number · default 1.0

Share of eligible craters given bright material. Must be from 0 to 1.

background_maturity

number · default 0.202

Optical maturity (OMAT) of the ground around the craters; the excesses are added to it and the albedo is brightened from it. Must be positive.

max_maturity

number · default 0.42

Cap on the optical maturity where craters' excesses add up, at least the background; it limits how bright overlapping craters get.

interior_excess

number · default 0.132

Optical maturity above the background inside a fresh crater's rim; higher values give brighter interiors. Must not be negative.

ejecta_excess

number · default 0.076

Optical maturity above the background on a fresh crater's continuous ejecta at the rim, falling with distance. Must not be negative.

docs.title: splotches
docs.text:
Dark and bright splotches that secondary impacts of loose regolith leave over the whole surface, after Speyerer et al. (2016).

seed

integer · default 0

Seed of where splotches fall and what they are.

rate_coefficient

number · default 1.483e-11

Coefficient a of the cumulative formation rate a d^-b per km^2 per year, d the diameter in km; higher values give more splotches. Must be positive.

rate_exponent

number · default 4.144

Slope b of the cumulative formation rate; higher values give relatively more small splotches. Must be positive.

lifetime_myr

number · default 0.081 · unit Myr

How long a splotch lasts in Myr, fading linearly; the default is the time splotches take to churn the top centimeters. Must be positive.

min_diameter_m

number · default 1.0 · unit m

Smallest splotch diameter in meters; the published fit is extrapolated below 10 m. Must be positive.

max_diameter_m

number · default 40.0 · unit m

Largest splotch diameter in meters, above the smallest. Must be positive.

dark_share

number · default 0.907

Share of splotches darker than the ground. Must be from 0 to 1.

bright_share

number · default 0.074

Share of splotches brighter than the ground; the rest are mixed, dark on one side and bright on the other. Must be from 0 to 1.

steep_bright_share

number, optional · default null

Share of splotches on slopes steeper than the steep slope that are bright, read from the terrain's heights; unset keeps the bright share. Bright splotches are found mostly on such slopes, but the source gives no share. Must be from 0 to 1.

steep_slope_deg

number · default 15.0 · unit deg

Slope in degrees from which ground is steep. Must be above 0 and below 90 deg.

softness

number · default 0.3

Share of a splotch's radius over which its edge fades. Must be above 0 and at most 1.

raggedness

number · default 0.15

Share of a splotch's radius that lobes of its edge pull in by; 0 keeps it round. Must be from 0 to below 1.

fade_px

list of number · default [...] · unit px

How splotches too small to resolve at the sample spacing fade out. Each must not be negative.

fade_shape

one of linear, smoothstep, smootherstep, gaussian · default "smoothstep"

Curve of the fade between the two sample counts of fade_px.

dark_change: Reflectance change of a dark splotch relative to the ground before it, drawn per splotch; above -1. kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

b

number · default 0.0

The uniform's upper bound, or the standard deviation (of the natural logarithm for a log-normal); unused for a constant.

min

number, optional · default null

Lower bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded below.

max

number, optional · default null

Upper bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded above, which normal and log-normal kinds do not allow.

edges

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the edges of the bins, at least two and strictly increasing; values are uniform within each bin. Empty for every other kind.

weights

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

bright_change: Reflectance change of a bright splotch, drawn per splotch; above -1. kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

b

number · default 0.0

min

max

number, optional · default null

edges

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the edges of the bins, at least two and strictly increasing; values are uniform within each bin. Empty for every other kind.

weights

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

swarms: Swarms of splotches around new craters; off by default. enabled

boolean · default false

Gives new craters swarms of splotches, their ejecta's secondaries (Robinson et al. 2015); off by default.

crater_rate

number · default 4.84e-06

New craters at least 10 m across per km^2 per year; 4.84e-6 from Speyerer et al. (2016). Must be positive.

crater_slope

number · default 3.06

Cumulative size slope of the new craters; the Neukum production function has 2.97 to 3.15. Must be positive.

min_crater_diameter_m

number · default 10.0 · unit m

Smallest crater with a swarm, in meters; smaller craters throw few splotches. Must be positive.

max_crater_diameter_m

number · default 50.0 · unit m

Largest crater with a swarm, in meters. Must be positive.

reference_diameter_m

number · default 18.8 · unit m

Diameter in meters of the crater whose swarm was counted: 18.8 m, Robinson et al. Must be positive.

reference_count

number · default 248.0

Splotches of the reference crater: 248 within 30 km, Robinson et al. Must be positive.

mu

number · default 0.41

Velocity exponent of the target; 0.41 for sand (Housen and Holsapple 2011). Counts grow as D^(3 + 1.5 mu) and landing distances fall as r^(-1.5 mu). Must be above 0 and below 1.

min_range_m

number · default 4300.0 · unit m

Nearest landing distance in meters, setting Robinson et al.'s median of 8.7 km. Must be positive.

max_range_m

number · default 30000.0 · unit m

Farthest landing distance in meters. Must be positive.

dark_share

number · default 0.9637096774193549

Share of swarm splotches darker than the ground. Must be from 0 to 1.

bright_share

number · default 0.012096774193548387

Share brighter than the ground; the rest are mixed. Must be from 0 to 1.

wedge_share

number · default 0.2

Share of swarm splotches shaped as wedges pointing back to their crater. Illustrative. Must be from 0 to 1.

wedge_elongation

number · default 2.0

Long over short axis of a wedge. Illustrative. Must be at least 1.

splotch_diameter: Diameter of a swarm splotch in meters, drawn per splotch: 2 to 22 m, median 6 m. kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

b

number · default 0.0

The uniform's upper bound, or the standard deviation (of the natural logarithm for a log-normal); unused for a constant.

min

number, optional · default null

Lower bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded below.

max

number, optional · default null

Upper bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded above, which normal and log-normal kinds do not allow.

list of number · default []

weights

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

bright_change: Reflectance change of a bright swarm splotch. kind

one of constant, uniform, normal, log_normal, piecewise · default "constant"

Kind of distribution the value is drawn from.

a

number · default 0.0

The constant value, the uniform's lower bound, the normal's mean or the log-normal's median.

b

number · default 0.0

The uniform's upper bound, or the standard deviation (of the natural logarithm for a log-normal); unused for a constant.

min

number, optional · default null

Lower bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded below.

max

number, optional · default null

Upper bound drawn values are clamped to; unset leaves them unbounded above, which normal and log-normal kinds do not allow.

edges

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the edges of the bins, at least two and strictly increasing; values are uniform within each bin. Empty for every other kind.

weights

list of number · default []

With piecewise, the relative weight of each bin, one fewer than the edges and not all zero; each bin draws its share of the total. Empty for every other kind. Each must not be negative.

craters[]: New craters given by hand, such as an observed impact, each throwing a swarm. x

number · default 0.0

Center along x in the surface's coordinates; the longitude in degrees on a sphere.

y

number · default 0.0

Center along y in the surface's coordinates; the latitude in degrees on a sphere.

diameter_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Rim-to-rim diameter, in meters. Must be positive.

age_gyr

number · default 0.0 · unit Gyr

Age in Gyr; older craters are more degraded under a degradation model and are applied earlier in oldest-first order. Must not be negative.

id

integer · default 0

Stable ID that seeds the crater's outline; 0 derives one from its position and diameter.

depth_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Rim-to-floor depth in meters, in place of the one the degradation model and age give; unset keeps the model's. Must be positive.

rim_height_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Height of the rim crest above the surface the crater formed on, in meters; needs a depth. Unset lowers the fresh rim in proportion to the depth. Must not be negative.

replace

boolean · default false

Replaces whatever the terrain holds there with a sharp crater of this diameter and depth, cut into a plane fitted around it, such as a crater a DEM holds blurred; apply.replacement sets how far. It takes the irregular outline, secondaries and albedo generated craters get.

docs.title: blast_zones
docs.text:
Brighter zones of regolith around landers scoured by their descent engines, after Clegg et al. (2014) and Clegg-Watkins et al. (2016).

zones[]: One blast zone per lander. x

number · default 0.0

Surface x of the lander.

y

number · default 0.0

Surface y of the lander.

area

number · default 28785.0 · unit m^2

Area of the blast zone in m^2; measured: Apollo 18,725 to 53,872 (mean 28,785), Luna 987 to 3355 (mean 2100), Surveyor 131 to 279 (mean 215), Chang'e-3 2530. Must be positive.

elongation

number · default 1.14

Long over short axis of the zone; Apollo about 1.14, Chang'e-3 about 1.74. Must be at least 1.

heading_deg

number · default 90.0 · unit deg

Direction of the long axis, degrees counter-clockwise from east, such as along the final approach.

change

number · default 0.109

Mean reflectance change over the zone relative to undisturbed ground at 30 degrees phase; measured +3.4% to +13.2%, Apollo mean +10.9%. Must be above -1.

halo_change

number · default 0.04

Reflectance change of the fainter halo beyond the zone; +4% at Chang'e-3. Must be above -1.

halo_reach

number · default 1.9

How far the halo reaches over the zone's own reach; 1 for no halo. Must be at least 1.

core_radius_m

number · default 0.0 · unit m

Radius in meters of the darker core beneath the engine and around the crew's tracks; 0 for none, a few meters at the Apollo sites. Must not be negative.

core_change

number · default -0.2

Reflectance change of the dark core; -15% to -30% at the Apollo sites. Must be above -1.

raggedness

number · default 0.15

Share of the zone's radius that lobes of its edge pull in by. Must be from 0 to below 1.

seed

integer · default 0

Varies the edge's lobes.

Every key with its default 
{
    "type": "blast_zones",
    "zones": []
}

docs.title: rocks
docs.text:
Rock brighter than the regolith: the boulders of boulder layers where resolved, and a speckle of the share of each sample covered by those too small to resolve.

boulder_layer

integer, optional · default null

Which top-level boulder layer's rock to brighten, counting from 0; unset uses every top-level boulder layer.

seed

integer · default 0

Seed of the per-sample draws of rock too small to resolve.

reflectance_ratio

number · default 2.5

Rock reflectance over the regolith's; 2.5 after Marshal et al. (2023), within Holt's (1981) Apollo 16 rocks at 18 to 51% against soils of 14 to 15%; earlier models used 1.5. Must be positive.

unresolved

boolean · default true

Brightens each sample by the share of it covered by boulders too small to resolve, drawn about the expected share with the scatter of randomly placed rocks: bright speckle.

Every key with its default 
{
    "type": "rocks",
    "boulder_layer": null,
    "seed": 0,
    "reflectance_ratio": 2.5,
    "unresolved": true
}

docs.title: slopes
docs.text:
Steep ground kept immature and bright by regolith moving downslope, after Ikeda et al. (2022) and Lucey et al. (2014).

onset_deg

number · default 20.0 · unit deg

Slope in degrees from which ground freshens; 20, where Lucey et al. (2014) and Ikeda et al. (2022) find brightening begin. Must be from 0 to below 90 deg.

maturity_per_degree

number · default 0.0065

Optical maturity (OMAT) gained per degree beyond the onset; about 0.0065 on the crater walls of Ikeda et al. (2022). Must not be negative.

background_maturity

number · default 0.1

OMAT of gentler ground; about 0.10 at 20 degrees in Laue (Ikeda et al. 2022). Must be positive.

max_maturity

number · default 0.42

Cap on OMAT; at least the background's. Must be positive.

baseline_m

number · default 10.0 · unit m

Meters slopes are measured over, the spacing of the lattice they are read on; 10, the DTM Ikeda et al. (2022) measured slopes on. Must be positive.

origin_reflectance

number · default 0.08

Reflectance of the optical maturity origin, from which reflectance scales with maturity at fixed iron content.

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text:
Chosen by "type" in outputs.

Type Description heightmap Writes the generated heights as a float32 GeoTIFF, with a raster source's projection. crater_list Writes the generated and manual craters as CSV or JSON. boulder_list Writes every boulder the layers placed, models and relief alike, as CSV or JSON. boulder_models Writes the boulders placed as 3D models on the ground: as a glTF scene (.glb, or .gltf with a .bin) drawing each shape once per boulder, as OBJ (.obj with an .mtl) with one object per boulder, or as one merged STL mesh (.stl). albedo Writes the albedo as a float32 GeoTIFF of one band or three (red, green, blue). mesh Writes the whole body, from six cube faces: a mesh as glTF (.glb or .gltf), OBJ (.obj) or STL (.stl), or a Gaskell ICQ shape model in kilometers (.icq), whose Q is cells_per_face. terrain_mesh Writes the generated heights as a triangle mesh, a vertex per cell with data, as glTF (.glb or .gltf), OBJ (.obj) or STL (.stl), in the frame boulder models are written in. materials Writes the material map as a float32 GeoTIFF of five bands: the share of soil, sand, dust, bedrock and rock at each cell. photometry Writes the Hapke parameters the materials mix to as a float32 GeoTIFF of four bands: single-scattering albedo, b, c and roughness in degrees. report A JSON report of what the configuration generates: height, slope, crater bin and boulder statistics per evaluated grid, per-layer timings, backend, threads, seeds and version.

docs.title: heightmap
docs.text:
Writes the generated heights as a float32 GeoTIFF, with a raster source's projection.

path

string · default ""

GeoTIFF file to write; unset to only return the result, writing nothing; relative paths resolve against the output folder (the CLI's --output-dir), else the configuration's folder.

pixel_size_m

number, optional · default null · unit m

Cell size in meters of the file; on a body, meters along a meridian, the same in degrees of longitude. Unset for the source's cell size; required without a raster or chain source. Must be positive.

compression

one of none, lzw, deflate, packbits · default "lzw"

Compression of the file; compressed files use the floating-point predictor.

tile_size_px

integer · default 256 · unit px

Width and height of the file's tiles in pixels; a multiple of 16. Must be at least 16 px.

extent_m: Box the output covers on a plane in meters, snapped outward from its min corner to whole cells; unset for the source's extent, required without a raster or chain source. center

list of number, optional · default null

[x, y] of the box's center; give it with size.

size

list of number, optional · default null

[width, height] of the box; give it with center. Each must be positive.

min

list of number, optional · default null

[x, y] of the box's lower corner; give it with max.

max

list of number, optional · default null

[x, y] of the box's upper corner, above min; give it with min.

extent_deg: As extent_m on a body, in degrees of longitude (x) and latitude (y). center

list of number, optional · default null

[x, y] of the box's center; give it with size.

size

list of number, optional · default null

[width, height] of the box; give it with center. Each must be positive.

min

list of number, optional · default null

[x, y] of the box's lower corner; give it with max.

max

list of number, optional · default null

[x, y] of the box's upper corner, above min; give it with min.

Every key with its default 
{
    "type": "heightmap",
    "path": "",
    "pixel_size_m": null,
    "extent_m": null,
    "extent_deg": null,
    "compression": "lzw",
    "tile_size_px": 256
}

Unset for the source's cell size; required without a raster or chain source. Must be positive.
